data.title: Brainwash '72 [video]
data.author: petethomas
data.article_summary: 《Brainwash '72》是一段1972年发布的视频，由Tambarlee International Inc.制作，主题是戒烟和洗脑。视频通过一种奇特的方式试图帮助观众戒烟，包含一名陌生人在沙漠行走的长时间镜头，以及手术画面等令人不适的内容。该视频最初在一盘贴有麦当劳标签的Umatic录像带上发现，可能用于帮助员工戒烟。视频经过技术处理，上传至互联网档案馆，并提供了多种下载格式。观众需注意视频包含可能引发不适的画面。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：关于视频内容是否涉及洗脑、潜意识信息以及屏幕成瘾等问题的不同观点

不同观点：
• **thomassmith65** 认为该视频类似于2D版的《心灵点滴》（Brainstorm），将其视为一种技术或概念的展示，但没有深入讨论其潜在影响。
• **xbar** 以幽默的方式表达对视频内容的放松态度，表明视频并没有让他感到不安或受到影响。
• **superkuh** 认为视频内容荒谬，将其与当代对“屏幕成瘾”的道德恐慌相比较。他否认洗脑的存在，认为对屏幕影响的担忧是过度夸张的，并指出这种恐慌可能会导致对人类自主意志的忽视，甚至引发控制行为。
• **trod1234** 持完全相反的观点，认为该视频是一种软性宣传，目的是通过荒谬的表现形式来削弱对媒体操控和潜意识信息影响的讨论。他详细介绍了洗脑和思想改造的历史背景，认为这些现象是真实且危险的，并引用了Joost Meerloo、Robert Lifton等人的研究来支持自己的观点。

补充讨论：
• **对洗脑和潜意识信息的不同看法**：superkuh认为洗脑不存在，而屏幕成瘾等问题是被夸大的；trod1234则坚信洗脑和思想改造是真实且危险的现象，并提供了相关历史和研究支持。
• **对视频目的的不同解读**：superkuh认为视频旨在展示荒谬内容，而trod1234则认为视频是故意设计得荒谬以削弱对潜意识信息影响的关注。
• **具体例子和论据**：trod1234引用了大量研究和文献，如Joost Meerloo的《心灵强奸》、Robert Lifton的《思想改革与极权主义心理学》以及Robert Cialdini的《影响力》，来支持他的观点，即洗脑和潜意识信息对人类心理有实际影响。
• **争议焦点**：争议的核心在于洗脑和潜意识信息是否真实存在，以及屏幕成瘾等现代问题是否被过度夸大。superkuh持怀疑态度，而trod1234则坚信这些问题的严重性和真实性。

通过这些观点的分析，可以看出讨论的焦点集中在对洗脑、潜意识信息和屏幕影响的认知差异，以及这些现象在现代社会中的实际影响。

• **thomassmith65** 认为该视频类似于2D版的《心灵点滴》（Brainstorm），将其视为一种技术或概念的展示，但没有深入讨论其潜在影响。
• **xbar** 以幽默的方式表达对视频内容的放松态度，表明视频并没有让他感到不安或受到影响。
• **superkuh** 认为视频内容荒谬，将其与当代对“屏幕成瘾”的道德恐慌相比较。他否认洗脑的存在，认为对屏幕影响的担忧是过度夸张的，并指出这种恐慌可能会导致对人类自主意志的忽视，甚至引发控制行为。
• **trod1234** 持完全相反的观点，认为该视频是一种软性宣传，目的是通过荒谬的表现形式来削弱对媒体操控和潜意识信息影响的讨论。他详细介绍了洗脑和思想改造的历史背景，认为这些现象是真实且危险的，并引用了Joost Meerloo、Robert Lifton等人的研究来支持自己的观点。

补充讨论：
• **对洗脑和潜意识信息的不同看法**：superkuh认为洗脑不存在，而屏幕成瘾等问题是被夸大的；trod1234则坚信洗脑和思想改造是真实且危险的现象，并提供了相关历史和研究支持。
• **对视频目的的不同解读**：superkuh认为视频旨在展示荒谬内容，而trod1234则认为视频是故意设计得荒谬以削弱对潜意识信息影响的关注。
• **具体例子和论据**：trod1234引用了大量研究和文献，如Joost Meerloo的《心灵强奸》、Robert Lifton的《思想改革与极权主义心理学》以及Robert Cialdini的《影响力》，来支持他的观点，即洗脑和潜意识信息对人类心理有实际影响。
• **争议焦点**：争议的核心在于洗脑和潜意识信息是否真实存在，以及屏幕成瘾等现代问题是否被过度夸大。superkuh持怀疑态度，而trod1234则坚信这些问题的严重性和真实性。

通过这些观点的分析，可以看出讨论的焦点集中在对洗脑、潜意识信息和屏幕影响的认知差异，以及这些现象在现代社会中的实际影响。

data.title: Ask HN: How did Soham Parekh get so many jobs?
data.author: jshchnz
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：对Soham事件的多角度分析，涉及招聘、多重就业和公司管理问题。

不同观点：
• 一些评论认为Soham是一个非常有才华的工程师，面试表现极为出色，如gargoyle9123和dazzeloid所言，他轻松通过面试，技术能力出众，但在实际工作中表现不佳，频繁找借口。
• Tade0则认为，部分员工能够同时胜任两个工作是因为大公司对绩效的期望范围有限，只要达到预期就不会有额外好处，这种现象促使一些员工选择多重就业。
• ungreased0675指出，很多公司可能在招聘过程中存在“货物崇拜”问题，过度追求顶尖人才，而实际上普通工程师即可满足需求，这种追求可能导致招聘失败。
• tabs_or_spaces对那些声称Soham是顶级工程师却无法在工作中有效表现的公司提出质疑，认为这些公司在招聘过程中存在失误。
• isatty批评那些仅凭LeetCode面试表现就断定一个人是优秀工程师的观点，认为这种招聘方式存在问题。
• jsbg提到就业资格审查的重要性，指出如果公司没有做好这方面的检查，会带来潜在风险。
• robswc和dazzeloid都提到Soham同时在多个公司工作的现象，并对其成功率表示疑惑，质疑他是否通过低薪或者其他手段获得这些职位。
• altairprime认为多重就业就像婚姻中的不忠，虽然不被普遍接受，但如果员工能在规定范围内完成工作，公司没有理由抱怨。
• jcadam指出当前软件工程求职市场的困境，很多人无法得到回复，而像Soham这样的情况则让人感到不公平。
• dalemhurley提到一个Reddit小组，讨论如何同时从事多份工作，认为这种现象在创业公司中尤其值得关注。
• jm20推测Soham可能通过某种团队或结构来维持多重就业，并认为大公司的结构和流程在这方面有优势。
• bibek_poudel认为Soham擅长通过邮件和沟通展示自己为高绩效者，这可能是他通过多次面试的原因。
• mathverse批评美国公司在雇佣第三世界国家员工时的双重标准，认为这种做法存在问题。
• baceituno表示他们在面试Soham时发现他具备扎实的全栈技能，但也能看出他有其他事情在身，因此没有录用他。

补充讨论：
• 招聘过程中对顶尖人才的过度追求可能导致的问题。
• 大公司与创业公司在员工管理与绩效评估方面的差异。
• 多重就业现象的普遍性及其对公司和员工关系的影响。
• 就业资格审查和背景调查在招聘过程中的重要性。
• 对不同招聘方式（如LeetCode面试）的有效性讨论。
• 美国公司在雇佣国际员工时的法律和道德考虑。

data.title: Rules of good writing (2007)
data.author: santiviquez
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：关于写作风格、简洁性、以及不同语言和文体对写作的影响的讨论。

不同观点：
• mtlynch: 认为读者理解“the boy hit the ball”比“the ball was hit by the boy”更快，因为英语中主语→动词→宾语的结构更常见。但怀疑这种理解方式可能仅适用于英语，并不一定适用于所有语言。
• kens: 提到大多数写作指南都是Strunk & White的复述，但推荐了"Style: Toward Clarity and Grace"作为更高级的选择。
• wduquette: 对纠正一个18年前的评论感到无奈，认为纠正过时的观点是徒劳的。
• raincole: 指出写作规则具有情境性，不同领域（如科技创业和文学杂志）对写作风格的要求不同，没有绝对的规则。
• CharlesW: 认为Strunk的“省略不必要的词”是好的商业写作建议，但对于想要深入写作 craft 的人，推荐Stephen King的《On Writing》。
• GGByron: 强调简洁不仅仅是去掉多余的词，还包括避免陈词滥调。认为Adams没有引用Orwell，也没有解释清楚概念。
• djoldman: 赞同简洁性，引用Hemingway的观点，认为应该删减句子中的多余词汇。
• irchans: 纠正mtlynch的评论，指出应该是“主语（the boy）在动作（the hitting）之前”，而不是“对象（the boy）”。
• Labov: 认为简洁的写作建议适用于博客作者和记者，但不一定适合小说家或诗人。
• m0llusk: 幽默地提到rap音乐的兴起是否与写作简洁性有关。
• jbreckmckye: 认为清晰和简短虽然是好的开始，但并不足够，还需要更多的修饰和内容。引用Calvin Coolidge的例子来说明过于简短的弊端。
• lutusp: 质疑“好写作的规则”这一说法，认为标题本身是一个词汇错误，应该关注的是选择而不是价值。提到Strunk & White的影响，并幽默地表示自己“煮掉”了这本书，只剩下“让每个词都有价值”这一点。
• CalChris: 认为Adams给出了好的建议，但过于简洁的写作可能不会让人记住作者。

补充讨论：
• 关于写作简洁性和规则的普遍适用性存在争议，不同文体和领域对写作风格的要求不同。
• 对Strunk & White的观点和影响有不同的评价，有人推荐更高级的写作指南。
• 评论中还涉及到对过时评论的无奈，以及对写作建议的幽默调侃。

争议焦点：
• 写作简洁性的适用范围和程度，特别是在不同文体和语言中的应用。
• 对传统写作规则的遵循与突破，以及这些规则是否真正有助于提升写作质量。

data.title: Xenharmlib: A music theory library that supports non-western harmonic systems
data.author: retooth
data.article_summary: Xenharmlib 0.3.0 是一个支持传统和非传统音乐理论的Python库，特别适用于非十二平均律系统的微音程和宏音程调音。它易于使用且可扩展，支持西方和非西方音阶系统、非标准记谱法以及音程、音阶的分析与调制建议。该库还提供对波尔-皮尔斯调音的群论分析等功能。Xenharmlib 并非用于乐谱编写或合成，而是专注于和声关系的科学探索，采用函数式编程原则，对象为不可变类型。未来计划包括支持更多记谱法、高级后调性分析和Just Intonation等。该库基于GNU Public License v3发布，源代码托管于Gitlab，并有Discord社区支持。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：音乐国际化（music-i18n）、软件工具开发及其应用

不同观点：
• [ksr] 提出音乐国际化（music-i18n）的概念，类似于为支持世界语言和地域文化添加软件层，但这里是针对音乐调式和音律。他特别关注以下几方面：
  - 支持非十二平均律调音（non-ET tunings）
  - 支持四音列及其他音阶构造块，如阿拉伯音阶（ajnas）
  - 导入/导出MusicXML
  - 导出至MIDI

• [sim7c00] 关心是否存在类似功能的C++实现。他认为C++是开发VST插件等数字乐器和DSP工具的常用语言，并提到JUCE框架作为例子。

• [bntr] 提到自己开发了一个与xenharmonic相关的库，主要关注视觉和和声空间，并提供了GitHub链接和演示视频。他还询问了关于xenharmlib库在音乐创作中的实际应用，并猜测某张专辑是否使用了该库。

补充讨论：
• [max_] 提问是否有好的资源可以学习基础乐理，尤其是音名（如A, B, C）的意义以及它们如何构成实际的音乐。

争议焦点：
• 目前讨论中没有明显的争议，但不同用户对工具的实现语言（如[sim7c00] 对C++的关注）和具体功能（如[ksr] 对非ET调音和音阶构造块的支持）表现出不同的兴趣和侧重点。

讨论关系：
• [ksr] 提出了音乐国际化的广泛计划和具体技术需求。

Audience & Design Philosophy
¶
Xenharmlib is targeted at composers and researchers who already have
basic knowledge in python programming.
Xenharmlib does
not
aim to be a score composition tool, sequencer,
or synthesizer (however it is possible to build such things on top of
it). Rather it wants to provide a toolset for exploring different
concepts of harmonic relations with a scientific focus.
Xenharmlib is object-oriented but mostly designed around functional
programming principles: Objects are considered immutable and methods
do not alter internal states but return modified versions of the
original object.
Features
¶
A selection of things supported by xenharmlib:
Equal division tunings (e.g. Western, Modern Arabic, Turkish Makam,
Bohlen-Pierce, Wendy Carlos’ Gamma Scale)
Western notation (including interval naming)
Up/Down notation (a superset of Western notation)
Analysis of intervals, scales, and their relations to one another
Group theoretical analysis (integer pitches, pitch classes, etc)
Interval sequence pattern matching
Modulation suggestions for arbitrary key changes
Basic posttonal analysis (normal & prime form calculations, inversion, etc)
Roadmap
¶
A list of planned features (not necessarily in chronological order):
Templates for Western music
Plugin interface for score rendering backends
Advanced posttonal analysis (interval vectors, z-Relations, Forte numbers)
Rothenberg propriety and interval matrices
MOS scale generation utilities
Just Intonation and prime limit tunings
Extended Helmholtz-Ellis JI Pitch Notation
Odd Limit Tunings
Arel-Ezgi-Uzdilek notation
License
¶

GNU Public License v3

You can find the source code hosted on
Gitlab.com
Acknowledgments

Kite Giedraitis
and
Lumi Pakkanen
and everyone else on the
Xenharmonic Alliance Discord who was patient with me when I was
struggling to implement UpDownNotation.
Support and Contact
¶
If you want to ask for a new feature or report a bug, take it to the
Gitlab issue page

In case you just wanna chat with the maintainer: I often hang around on

data.title: Bulgaria to join euro area on 1 January 2026
data.author: toomuchtodo
data.article_summary: 保加利亚将于2026年1月1日加入欧元区，汇率定为1.95583列弗兑1欧元。保加利亚于2020年加入欧盟汇率机制（ERM II），其货币汇率自那时起一直保持在该水平。自2020年10月1日起，欧洲央行（ECB）开始直接监管保加利亚的四家主要金融机构，并 oversight 其他13家较小机构。保加利亚在ERM II中的表现符合加入欧元区的趋同标准，ECB和保加利亚国民银行将共同监控其汇率直至2026年。媒体咨询联系人：Benoit Deeg，电话：+49 172 1683 704。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：欧元区的扩张及其影响

不同观点：
• 支持欧元扩张的观点：
   - 欧元作为单一货币已经成功运行了26年，并且仍在扩展（decimalenough）。
   - 欧元帮助各国以较低利率获得贷款，减少货币市场不稳定的风险（16th_hop）。
   - 欧元在减少美元主导地位方面具有积极意义（v5v3）。

• 对欧元扩张持怀疑或批评的观点：
   - 担心欧元区国家经济实力不同，统一货币和中央管理并不理想（v5v3）。
   - 希腊的教训：加入欧元区可能导致经济困境，特别是无法通过货币贬值来缓解经济问题（ktsangop）。
   - 引入欧元可能导致物价显著上涨，类似情况曾在其他国家发生过（theodric, jmyeet, storus）。

• 对欧元实际影响的讨论：
   - 欧元在日常生活中并未带来太大变化，但其象征意义和政治意义重大（SwtCyber）。
   - 一些用户担心旅游业的发展可能导致地方独特性的丧失（keiferski）。

补充讨论：
• 关于欧元引入后物价变化的研究不足，历史上的转换如德国和法国的经验值得参考（jmyeet）。
• 欧元购买力下降的问题，以及通过电视广告宣传引入欧元的必要性受到质疑（ingohelpinger）。

争议焦点：
• 欧元引入对经济的长远影响，特别是对新加入国家如保加利亚的经济影响存在争议。一方面是经济整合和贷款成本降低的优势，另一方面是物价上涨和经济自主性丧失的风险。

PRESS RELEASE
Bulgaria to join euro area on 1 January 2026
8 July 2025
Conversion rate of lev fixed at 1.95583 = EUR 1
Bulgaria joined the ERM II in 2020
Bulgarian banks supervised by ECB since 2020
Today the Council of the European Union formally approved the accession of Bulgaria to the euro area on 1 January 2026 and determined a Bulgarian lev conversion rate of 1.95583 per euro. This is the current central rate of the lev in the Exchange Rate Mechanism (ERM II), which the currency joined on 10 July 2020. The European Central Bank (ECB) and Българска народна банка (Bulgarian National Bank) agreed to monitor developments in the Bulgarian lev against the euro on the foreign exchange market until 1 January 2026.
With the entry into force of the
close cooperation framework between the ECB and Българска народна банка (Bulgarian National Bank)
, the ECB has been responsible for directly supervising four significant institutions and overseeing 13 less significant institutions in Bulgaria since 1 October 2020.
For media queries, please contact
Benoit Deeg
, tel.: +49 172 1683 704.
Notes
The agreement to monitor the lev is in the context of ERM II. Participation in ERM II and observance of the normal fluctuation margins for at least the last two years is one of the convergence criteria to be fulfilled ahead of euro area accession.
The conversion rate of the lev is set by way of an amendment to Regulation (EC) No 2866/98, which will become effective on 1 January 2026.

data.title: New Horizons images enable first test of interstellar navigation
data.author: jnord
data.article_summary: NASA's New Horizons spacecraft, currently traveling through the Kuiper Belt, has demonstrated the first example of interstellar navigation using the parallax effect. Due to its vast distance from Earth, stars like Proxima Centauri and Wolf 359 appear in different positions compared to Earth's view. Astronomers, led by Tod Lauer, used this shift to calculate New Horizons' position by comparing its photos with the Gaia space telescope's star map. Although less accurate than NASA’s Deep Space Network (DSN), this method could improve with better equipment and may offer advantages for future interstellar missions by providing autonomous, more accurate location readings over long distances. However, no current missions are planned for such deep space exploration.

主要讨论点：关于不同天文导航方法的准确性及媒体来源的可信度

不同观点：
• [aerospades] 认为视差法的精度较低，只能将新视野号（New Horizons）定位在一个半径为6000万公里的球体内，这大约是地球到太阳距离的一半。相比之下，NASA的SEXTANT任务利用脉冲星导航可以将误差控制在约10公里，且该方法在星际空间中仍然有效。尽管视差法精度不高，但其创新性依然值得肯定，因为新视野号是在2006年发射的，技术相对较老。

44484557.article_content:
Artist’s illustration of NASA’s New Horizons spacecraft in the outer solar system
Joe Olmsted/STScI
As it hurtles out of our solar system, NASA’s
New Horizons
spacecraft is so far from Earth that the stars in the Milky Way appear in markedly different positions compared with our own view. Astronomers have now used this change in perspective to work out the probe’s position in the galaxy, in the first ever example of interstellar navigation.
New Horizons was launched in 2006, initially to
study Pluto
, but it has since travelled way beyond this point, ploughing on through the Kuiper belt, a vast, wide band of rocks and dust billions of miles from the sun. It is now speeding at tens of thousands of kilometres per hour.
Read more
This mind-blowing map shows Earth’s position within the vast universe
Advertisement
When gazing at the night sky from Earth, the stars are so far away that they don’t appear to change positions when viewed from different locations, unless you have a powerful telescope. But from New Horizons’ viewpoint, there is a significant change in star positions due to the parallax effect. This was
demonstrated
in 2020 when the probe beamed back pictures of two nearby stars, Proxima Centauri and Wolf 359, to Earth.
Now,
Tod Lauer
at the US National Optical-Infrared Astronomy Research Laboratory in Arizona and his colleagues have used this effect to work out the position of New Horizons. They did it by comparing the probe’s photos of Proxima Centauri and Wolf 359 with measurements from the Gaia space telescope, which has produced the most detailed map of stars in our Milky Way.
“We have a good enough three-dimensional map of the galaxy around us that you can find out where you are,” says Lauer. “It’s a remarkable accuracy, with your own camera [on board a spacecraft].”
Free newsletter
Sign up to Launchpad
Bring the galaxy to your inbox every month, with the latest space news, launches and astronomical occurrences from New Scientist’s Leah Crane.
Sign up to newsletter
To calculate the spacecraft’s position, he and his team looked at the position of the stars as they appeared from New Horizons’ on-board camera, drawing a line of sight back from both stars and working out where the two lines were closest. Then, they used the precise position of both stars from Gaia’s star map to work out where this point was in relation to the solar system.
This two-frame animation shows the shifting position of Proxima Centauri as viewed from Earth and New Horizons
Almost all spacecraft calculate their bearings to within tens of metres using NASA’s Deep Space Network (DSN), a collection of radio transmitters on Earth that send regular signals out to space. In comparison, the parallax method was far less accurate, locating New Horizons within a sphere with a radius of 60 million kilometres, about half the distance between Earth and the sun.
“We’re not going to put the Deep Space Network out of business – this is only a demo proof of concept,” says Lauer. However, with a better camera and equipment they could improve the accuracy by up to 100 times, he says.
Read more
Why we must investigate Phobos, the solar system's strangest object
Using this technique for interstellar navigation could offer advantages over the DSN because it could give more accurate location readings as a spacecraft gets further away from Earth, as well as being able to operate autonomously without needing to wait for a radio signal to come from our solar system, says
Massimiliano Vasile
at the University of Strathclyde, UK.
“If you travel to an actual star, we are talking about light years,” says Vasile. “What happens is that your signal from the Deep Space Network has to travel all the way there and then all the way back, and it’s travelling at the speed of light, so it takes years.”
However, there are no missions in the works to go deep into interstellar space by any agency, says Vasile, so the utility of this particular technique is limited until one takes shape, he says.

data.article_summary: 这篇文章简要介绍了计算机中的缓存机制及其重要性。缓存通过将常用数据存储在高速存储器中，减少对慢速存储的访问，从而提高系统性能。文章解释了缓存的基本原理，包括缓存的命中率（hit rate）和未命中率（miss rate），以及如何通过增加缓存大小来提高命中率，但这也带来了成本和复杂性的增加。文章还描述了计算机中不同层次的缓存，如随机存取存储器（RAM）作为硬盘和中央处理器（CPU）之间的中间存储，以及现代CPU中内置的多层缓存。这些缓存机制共同作用，确保计算机操作的快速和高效。

Caching
By
Ben Dicken
|
July 8, 2025
Every time you use a computer,
caches
work to ensure your experience is fast.
Everything a computer does from executing an instruction on the CPU, to requesting your X.com feed, to loading this very webpage, relies heavily on caching.
You are about to enjoy a guided, interactive tour of caching: the most elegant, powerful, and pervasive innovation in computing.
Foundation
Everything we do with our computers requires
data
.
When you log into your email, all your messages and contacts are stored as data on a server.
When you browse the photo library on your iPhone, they are stored as data on your phone's storage and/or iCloud.
When you loaded this article, it had to fetch the data from a web server.
When designing systems to store and retrieve data, we are faced with trade-offs between capacity, speed, cost, and durability.
Hard-Disk Drives are cheaper per-gigabyte than Solid-State Drives, but the latter are lower latency.
Random-Access Memory is faster than both of the above, but is more expensive and volatile.
For a given budget, you can either get a large amount of slower data storage, or a small amount of faster storage.
Engineers get around this by combining the two: Pair a large amount of cheaper slow storage with a small amount of expensive fast storage.
Data that is accessed more
frequently
can go in the fast storage, and the other data that we use less often goes in the slow storage.
This is the core principle of caching.
Note
If you're hype about
PlanetScale for Postgres
, try Postgres mode:
We can see this visualized below.
Each colored square represents a unique datum we need to store and retrieve.
You can click on the "data requester" to send additional requests for data or click on any of the colored squares in the "slow + large" section to initiate a request that color.
Every time we request a piece of data, the request is first sent to the cache.
If it's there, we consider it a
cache hit
and quickly send the data back.
If we don't find it, we call it a
cache miss
.
At this point we pass the request on to the slow storage, find the data, send it back to the cache, and then send it to the requester.
Hit rate
The "hit rate" is the percentage of time we get
cache hits
.
In other words:
hit_rate = (cache_hits / total_requests) x 100
We want to keep the hit rate as high as possible.
Doing so means we are minimizing the number requests to the slower storage.
In the setup below we have a small cache, many items to store, and our requests for the items are coming in with no predictable pattern.
This leads to a low hit rate.
You can see the hit rate for the above cache and how it changes over time in the bar chart below.
What if instead we have a cache that is nearly the size of our data, with the same random requests pattern?
In this case, we are able to achieve a much higher hit rate.
Increasing the size of our cache increases cost and complexity in our data storage system.
It's all about trade-offs.
Your computer
Perhaps the most widespread form of caching in computers is Random-Access Memory (RAM).
The CPU of a computer is what does all of the "work."
Some call the CPU the brain of a computer.
A brain needs memory to work off of, otherwise it isn't much use.
Any information computers want to store permanently get stored on the
hard drive
.
Hard drives are great because they can remember things even when the computer gets shut off or runs out of battery.
The problem is, hard drives are slow.
Click on "CPU" in the visual below to send a request for data to storage.
You can also click on any of the colored squares on the "Hard Drive" section to request that specific element.
To get around this, we use RAM as an intermediate storage location between the CPU and the hard drive.
RAM is more expensive and has less storage capacity than the hard drive.
But the key is, data can be fetched from and written to RAM an order-of-magnitude faster than the time it takes to interact with the hard drive.
Because of this, computers will store a subset of the data from the hard drive, the stuff that needs to be accessed more frequently, in RAM.
Many requests for data will go to RAM and can be executed fast.
Occasionally, when the CPU needs something not already in RAM, it makes a request to the hard drive.
There are actually more layers of caching on a computer than just RAM and disk.
Modern CPUs have one or more cache layers for RAM.
Though RAM is fast, a cache built directly into the CPU is even faster, so frequently used values and variables can be stored there while a program is running to improve performance.

data.author: fremden
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：经典科幻与恐龙题材电影的续作质量、电影行业制作动机以及与原作的对比

不同观点：
• GMoromisato认为，《异形》、《终结者》和《黑客帝国》等系列电影在成功改变类型或颠覆预期后，续作难以重现原作的魅力。他指出，这些系列电影的成功往往依赖于前两部作品，后续作品缺乏创新空间。
• LeftHandPath强调，斯皮尔伯格的原作通过细致入微的探索和现实感的营造，使电影更具生命力。相比之下，后续电影缺乏对细节的关注，使得剧情显得不够真实和复杂。
• 0xbadcafebee指出，好电影难得，因为大多数大预算电影的目标是赚钱而非艺术质量。他批评电影行业更多关注票房收入而非影片质量，动作片因其刺激性而受欢迎。
• nullhole同意影评人Ebert的观点，认为原作中对恐龙的敬畏感在后来的电影中缺失，变成了标准的怪兽电影。
• bruce511赞赏《侏罗纪公园》中Ian Malcolm角色及其台词的深度，认为其对电影和生活的隐喻具有共鸣。
• losvedir质疑对原作的高评价是否源于怀旧，并提出这种评价可能是不理性的情感防御。
• conductr通过孩子的反应，指出有关恐龙灭绝原因的知识已经更新，反映出旧作品可能因时代局限而存在信息不准确的问题。
• csours对《侏罗纪公园》的开场场景和技术解说场景给予高度评价，认为其技术表现优异。
• ggm回顾了一些经典的恐龙题材电影，指出其影响和不足，同时提及一些非恐龙题材但相关的电影。
• yeahboats讨论了新作《重生》并认为其未能提供新意，且与原作相比缺乏深度。
• topkai22简单指出，质量较差的续作也能赚钱，因为电影首先是娱乐产品，尤其在大制作成本下，票房成功决定了续作的制作方向。
• jtrn认为，现代电影缺乏原创性，反复使用旧套路，与文章指责好莱坞缺乏创新相呼应。
• kevin_thibedeau和ivankelly补充了关于原作中科学细节的讨论，指出随着时间推移，科学理论的更新影响了观众对电影内容的理解。

补充讨论：
• 评论中多次提到原作与续作在细节处理、角色深度和剧情复杂性上的差异，反映了观众对电影质量的不同期望。
• 电影行业的商业动机与艺术追求之间的矛盾是另一个讨论焦点，特别是续作往往为了迎合市场而缺乏创新。
• 科学知识的更新和旧作中的信息过时问题也被提及，反映了电影在科学准确性上的时代局限。

data.title: What goes wrong when we write ghazals in English
data.author: ishita159
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：诗歌翻译，尤其是乌尔都语诗歌形式“嘎扎尔”翻译的挑战和本质。

不同观点：
• [lubujackson] 认为翻译诗歌本质上是变革性的，翻译过程中需要做出取舍，甚至要提升或创造某些元素。他提出翻译的目标是传递源材料的某些核心元素，而不是追求绝对的准确性。为了保留概念和情感，他放弃了押韵，因为这会导致与语言限制的冲突。
• [microflash] 认为将嘎扎尔翻译成英语本质上是不准确的，更准确的描述应是“准确的诠释”，因为这始终是一种解读。他强调语言和文化的差异会导致即使是并列阅读原文和译文，也会有显著或微妙的文化差异。此外，他指出嘎扎尔与伊斯兰文化圈无关，许多著名嘎扎尔诗人并不遵循伊斯兰教义。
• [boredgargoyle] 作为一个刚尝试翻译的人，感到在英语中遵循嘎扎尔的规则很混乱，表达了对翻译困难的理解。

补充讨论：
• [ishita159] 提到《The Oxford India Ghalib》一书，该书将原文和译文并列呈现，暗示这种双语版本可能为翻译的挑战提供解决方案或参考。

争议焦点：
• 翻译的目标和本质：是追求准确传递所有细节，还是允许诠释和创造以传达核心情感和概念。
• 嘎扎尔与伊斯兰文化的关系：对嘎扎尔是否属于伊斯兰文化圈的不同看法。
• 翻译中的文化与语言差异如何影响最终译文的理解和感受。

data.title: Product of Additive Inverses
data.author: blenderob
data.article_summary: 本文讨论了负负得正的数学规则，并通过一个例子展示了该规则的合理性。首先，通过分解 \(7 \times 8 = 56\) 的计算过程，利用分配律和负正得负的假设，推导出 \((-3) \times (-2) = 6\)。随后，文章从严谨的代数角度出发，介绍了环公理（ring axioms），这些公理定义了一类具有与数字类似性质的代数结构。环具有加法和乘法两种运算，满足结合律、交换律、分配律及存在加法逆元等性质。文章强调，这些代数结构无需具有所有数字的性质，只要满足环公理，负负得正的规则依然成立。环的例子包括整数、有理数、实数和复数等，甚至多项式集合也能构成环。最后，文章提到了一些关于闭包性质的补充公理，但指出这些通常被认为是冗余的，因为二元运算本身就隐含了闭包性。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：如何证明 (−a)(−b) = ab 以及该证明在不同数学框架下的应用

不同观点：
• CurtMonash 认为不需要中间定理，通过快速证明 ab 和 (−a)(−b) 都是 (−a)b 的加法逆元，可以直接得出它们相等。这种观点强调了证明的简洁性和直接性。
• empath75 提供了一个具体的例子，使用模 5 算术来说明即使在没有负数的情况下，这个公式仍然成立。他通过计算 2 * -3 的例子，展示了如何利用加法逆元得出相同结果，强调了具体计算过程和不同方法的验证。
• JadeNB 强调了从环公理出发的形式化证明，指出这个公式即使在没有正负数概念的环中也成立。JadeNB 还提到，尽管通常说“两个负数相乘结果为正数”，但实际上这与数字的正负无关，而是公理的直接结果。

补充讨论：
• empath75 的例子展示了在没有负数的情况下，如何通过环中的加法逆元验证公式，这与 CurtMonash 的简洁证明形成对比，提供了更具体的计算步骤。
• JadeNB 的评论则从更抽象的数学公理角度解释了公式的普遍适用性，并澄清了负数与正负号之间的关系，指出该公式在更广泛的数学结构中同样有效。
• 争议的焦点可能在于证明的复杂性和方法的选择：CurtMonash 强调简洁，而 empath75 提供了更详细的例子和步骤。JadeNB 则从理论上进行了更高层次的总结和澄清。

44471180.article_content:
Product of Additive Inverses
By
Susam Pal
on 29 May 2025
A negative number multiplied by another negative number results in a
positive number.  Most of us learnt this rule during our primary or
secondary school years.  'Negative times negative equals positive'
was a phrase drummed into us during mathematics lessons.  In this
article, we will prove this rule, not just for numbers but for any
algebraic structure that, in a general sense, behaves somewhat like
numbers.
Contents
Illustration
Ring Axioms
Closure Properties
Inverse of Inverse
Multiplication by Zero
Multiplication by Additive Inverse
Product of Additive Inverses
Conclusion
Illustration
Let us begin with a quick illustration that shows why the product of
two negative numbers must be positive for arithmetic to make sense.
Consider
\[
7 \times 8 = 56.
\]
The above equation can also be written as
\[
(10 - 3) \times (10 - 2) = 56.
\]
Using the distributive property of multiplication over subtraction,
we get
\[
(10 - 3) \times 10 + (10 - 3) \times (-2) = 56.
\]
Using the distributive property again, we have
\[
10 \times 10 + (-3) \times 10 + 10 \times (-2) + (-3) \times (-2) = 56.
\]
Now, we will take it for granted that a positive times a negative is
negative.  We will prove all of this rigorously later, but for now,
we are just working through an illustration, so we will accept that
rule and see where it leads.  The equation becomes:
\[
100 + (-30) + (-20) + (-3) \times (-2) = 56.
\]
Adding the first three terms gives
\[
50 + (-3) \times (-2) = 56.
\]
Subtracting \( 50 \) from both sides, we get
\[
(-3) \times (-2) = 6.
\]
What we have seen here is that if we accept \( 7 \times 8 = 56, \)
and that positive times negative gives a negative result, then we
must also accept that \( (-3) \times (-2) = 6.  \)
Ring Axioms
From this section onwards, we take a rigorous approach.  We want to
show that the rule 'negative times negative equals positive' holds,
in a general sense, for any set of elements that share certain
properties with numbers.  As it turns out, these elements do not
need to possess all the properties of complex numbers, real numbers,
or even rational numbers.  In fact, if they satisfy a small and
specific set of properties held by the integers, then the rule still
holds.  These properties are known as the
ring axioms
.
A ring is an algebraic structure consisting of a set \( R \) with
two binary operations \( + \) and \( \cdot, \) called addition and
multiplication respectively, satisfying the following axioms:
Associativity of addition:
For all \( a, b, c
\in R, \) we have \( a + (b + c) = (a + b) + c.  \)
Commutativity of addition:
For all \( a, b \in
R, \) we have \( a + b = b + a.  \)
Additive identity:
There exists an element \( 0
\in R \) such that for all \( a \in R, \) we have \( a + 0 = a =
0 + a.  \)
Additive inverse:
For each \( a \in R, \) there
exists an element \( -a \in R \) such that \( a + (-a) = 0 =
(-a) + a.  \)
Associativity of multiplication:
For all \( a,
b, c \in R, \) we have \( a \cdot (b \cdot c) = (a \cdot b)
\cdot c.  \)
Left distributivity of multiplication over
addition:
For all \( a, b, c \in R, \) we have \( a
\cdot (b + c) = (a \cdot b) + (a \cdot c).  \)
Right distributivity of multiplication over
addition:
For all \( a, b, c \in R, \) we have \( (b +
c) \cdot a = (b \cdot a) + (c \cdot a).  \)
Note that we do not assume that the ring contains multiplicative
identity, nor do we assume that multiplication is commutative.  Many
familiar types of numbers form rings.  For example, the set of
integers forms a ring with the usual addition and multiplication
operations.  The sets of rational numbers, real numbers, and complex
numbers satisfy the ring axioms too.
Rings need not consist of numbers; they may contain elements of any
type.  As long as a set of elements, together with suitable addition
and multiplication operations, satisfies the seven axioms above, it
forms a ring.  For example, the set of all polynomials in the
indeterminate \( t \) with coefficients in some ring \( R \) forms a
ring under the usual addition and multiplication of polynomials.
Such a ring is called a
polynomial ring
and it is denoted
\( R[t].  \)
Closure Properties
Some texts include the following additional axioms for the closure
properties of a ring:
Closure under addition:
For all
\( a, b \in R, \) we have \( a + b \in R.  \)
Closure under multiplication:
For all \( a, b
\in R, \) we have \( a \cdot b \in R.  \)
However, stating these axioms explicitly is usually considered
redundant because a binary operation is closed by definition.  A
binary operation \( \circ \) on a set \( M \) is defined to be a
function
\[
\circ : M \times M \to M; \quad (a, b) \mapsto a \circ b.
\]
This definition automatically implies the closure property, since
the domain and codomain are the same.  The addition and

44471180.article_summary: 本文讨论了负负得正的数学规则，并通过一个例子展示了该规则的合理性。首先，通过分解 \(7 \times 8 = 56\) 的计算过程，利用分配律和负正得负的假设，推导出 \((-3) \times (-2) = 6\)。随后，文章从严谨的代数角度出发，介绍了环公理（ring axioms），这些公理定义了一类具有与数字类似性质的代数结构。环具有加法和乘法两种运算，满足结合律、交换律、分配律及存在加法逆元等性质。文章强调，这些代数结构无需具有所有数字的性质，只要满足环公理，负负得正的规则依然成立。环的例子包括整数、有理数、实数和复数等，甚至多项式集合也能构成环。最后，文章提到了一些关于闭包性质的补充公理，但指出这些通常被认为是冗余的，因为二元运算本身就隐含了闭包性。

data.title: US Court nullifies FTC requirement for click-to-cancel
data.author: gausswho
data.article_summary: 美国联邦上诉法院推翻了一项“点击取消”规则，该规则要求公司使取消服务与注册一样简便。美国第八巡回上诉法院裁定，联邦贸易委员会（FTC）在制定该规则时未遵循完整的程序，特别是在规则经济影响超过1亿美元的情况下，未进行初步监管分析并征求公众意见。尽管法官们对FTC的动机表示同情，但指出程序缺陷是致命的。多个行业团体和企业，包括有线电视公司，联合起诉FTC。法院认为，FTC若不进行初步分析，可能为未来规则制定过程中的操纵打开大门。该规则原定于7月14日生效，但由于程序问题被取消。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：如何简化订阅取消流程及相关法律争议

不同观点：
• [postalrat] 认为银行或卡服务应提供一键取消所有订阅的功能，并表示如果有这样的卡服务会立即切换。
• [dalemhurley] 主张通过提高服务价值来留住客户，而不是通过设置取消障碍。
• [Irongirl1] 建议使用privacy.com创建一次性虚拟卡，以防止商家未经同意继续收费。
• [MengerSponge] 赞赏iOS应用商店的无摩擦取消功能，认为这使得试用订阅服务更加方便。
• [throwawaymaths] 提到Spectrum在取消服务时需要花费大量时间处理，反映了现实中的取消困难。

补充讨论：
• 法律争议：
  - [db48x] 提供了相关法律判决的链接供参考。
  - [fwlr] 指出FTC在制定规则时未遵循必要程序，导致规则未能通过法律审查。
  - [bpodgursky] 和 [tiahura] 详细讨论了FTC因未能进行初步监管分析而导致规则被撤销的法律背景。
  - [ars] 简要提到FTC因未遵循程序而被法院撤销规则。

• 对体制的批评：
  - [xyst] 批评美国制度偏袒富人和权贵，认为游戏规则被操纵。

• 是否应通过技术手段（如一键取消订阅功能）简化取消流程，还是通过提高服务质量来自然留住客户。
• FTC在规则制定过程中未遵循必要程序的法律争议，以及法院裁决的合理性。

A federal appeals court today struck down a "click-to-cancel" rule that would have required companies to make cancelling services as easy as signing up. The Federal Trade Commission rule was scheduled to take effect on July 14 but was vacated by the US Court of Appeals for the 8th Circuit.
A three-judge panel ruled unanimously that the Biden-era FTC, then led by Chair Lina Khan, failed to follow the full rulemaking process required under US law. "While we certainly do not endorse the use of unfair and deceptive practices in negative option marketing, the procedural deficiencies of the Commission's rulemaking process are fatal here," the
ruling
said.
Indicating their sympathy with the FTC's motivations, judges wrote that many Americans "have found themselves unwittingly enrolled in recurring subscription plans, continuing to pay for unwanted products or services because they neglected to cancel their subscriptions." Last year, the FTC updated its 1973 Negative Option Rule by "adding provisions that bar sellers from misrepresenting material facts and require disclosure of material terms, express consumer consent, and a simple cancellation mechanism," the ruling said.
The FTC is required to conduct a preliminary regulatory analysis when a rule has an estimated annual economic effect of $100 million or more. The FTC estimated in a Notice of Proposed Rulemaking (NPRM) that the rule would not have a $100 million effect.
But an administrative law judge later found that the rule's impact surpassed the threshold, observing that compliance costs would exceed $100 million "unless each business used fewer than twenty-three hours of professional services at the lowest end of the spectrum of estimated hourly rates," the 8th Circuit ruling said. Despite the administrative law judge's finding, the FTC did not conduct a preliminary regulatory analysis and instead "proceeded to issue only the final regulatory analysis alongside the final Rule," the judges' panel said.
FTC arguments rejected
Summarizing the FTC's arguments, judges said the agency contended that US law "did not require the Commission to conduct the preliminary regulatory analysis later in the rulemaking process," and that "any alleged error was harmless because the NPRM addressed alternatives to the proposed amendments to the 1973 [Negative Option] Rule and analyzed record-keeping and compliance costs."
Judges disagreed with the FTC, writing that "the statutory language, 'shall issue,' mandates a separate preliminary analysis for public review and comment 'in any case' where the Commission issues a notice of proposed rulemaking and the $100 million threshold is surpassed."
Numerous industry groups and businesses,
including cable companies
, sued the FTC in four federal circuit courts. The cases were consolidated at the 8th Circuit, where it was decided by Circuit Judges James Loken, Ralph Erickson, and Jonathan Kobes. Loken was appointed by George H.W. Bush, while Erickson and Kobes are Trump appointees.
The judges said the lack of a preliminary analysis meant that industry groups and businesses weren't given enough time to contest the FTC's findings:
By the time the final regulatory analysis was issued, Petitioners still did not have the opportunity to assess the Commission's cost-benefit analysis of alternatives, an element of the preliminary regulatory analysis not required in the final analysis. And the Commission's discussion of alternatives in the final regulatory analysis was perfunctory. It briefly mentioned two alternatives to the final Rule, either terminating the rulemaking altogether and continuing to rely on the existing regulatory framework or limiting the Rule's scope to negative option plans marketed in-person or through the mail. While the Commission's decision to bypass the preliminary regulatory analysis requirement was certainly not made in bad faith or an "outright dodge of APA [Administrative Procedure Act] procedures," Petitioners have raised 'enough uncertainty whether [their] comments would have had some effect if they had been considered,' especially in the context of a closely divided Commission vote that elicited a lengthy dissenting statement.
The 8th Circuit ruling said the FTC's tactics, if not stopped, "could open the door to future manipulation of the rulemaking process. Furnishing an initially unrealistically low estimate of the economic impacts of a proposed rule would avail the Commission of a procedural shortcut that limits the need for additional public engagement and more substantive analysis of the potential effects of the rule on the front end."
Republicans opposed rule
The FTC
issued the proposal
in March 2023 and voted 3-2 to approve the rule
in October 2024
, with Republican Commissioners Melissa Holyoak and Andrew Ferguson voting against it. Ferguson is now chairman of the FTC,

主要讨论点：跨时区远程工作的挑战与应对策略

不同观点：
• [therealfiona] 认为生活在理想地点（如夏威夷）的小代价可以接受，即使需要在凌晨4点参加会议。他们通过不午休、灵活调整工作时间来应对时差问题。
• [clvx] 分享了长期跨时区工作的负面经验，最终导致倦怠。尽管通信多为异步，但仍需要在非正常工作时间工作，导致精神疲惫。
• [ok_dad] 强调保持工作节奏的重要性，通过每天至少工作几小时来维持动力，同时保持生活的灵活性，不拘泥于传统的工作日安排。
• [mindwork] 指出时差带来的作息调整问题，但同时也强调高薪酬和每日站会的压力有助于保持动力。
• [ktallett] 认为并不需要每天都与海外团队保持联系，只要找到重叠的工作时间段即可，无需持续保持联系。
• [TheAlchemist] 认为跨时区工作具有两面性，取决于项目和人。晚上工作可能影响睡眠，但若项目有趣，效率会更高。
• [markx2] 描述了在无压力的情况下自我驱动完成工作的经验，尽管有时会工作很长时间，但全凭个人意愿。
• [8organicbits] 强调异步通信的重要性，认为时差较大的情况下，每天一小时的同步时间足够，但睡眠周期可能受到影响。
• [Someone] 分享了与测试团队时差9小时的良好合作经验，通过邮件进行异步沟通，避免了等待时间。
• [JohnFen] 提到与印度团队合作时，只能通过轮流在不便时间开会来解决时差问题，并建议分担不便。
• [joezydeco] 不建议与西部团队合作，因为对方往往会在他们的上午安排会议，而此时正是自己的午餐时间。

补充讨论：

data.title: CPU-X: CPU-Z for Linux
data.author: nateb2022
data.article_summary: CPU-X是一款免费开源的系统信息查看工具，适用于GNU/Linux和FreeBSD系统，类似于Windows下的CPU-Z。它可以通过GTK提供图形界面，或通过NCurses使用文本模式，还支持命令行下的数据导出。CPU-X可以报告处理器、主板、内存、系统、显卡及性能等方面的信息。用户可以从相关页面下载最新版本，并查阅README和wiki以获取安装指南和截图。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：开源工具的用户界面（UI）设计及其实用性

不同观点：
• **支持但提出UI批评**：[throw123xz]认为该工具本身不错，但对UI设计提出批评，指出开源项目通常在用户界面方面存在不足，特别是颜色搭配和图标设计，导致其仍然依赖Windows和macOS。这个评论表达了对开源项目UI问题的遗憾，同时也理解开发者的努力。

• **习惯于命令行工具**：[unixhero]表示已经习惯了使用命令行工具（如`cat /proc/cpuinfo`）查看系统信息，暗示对图形化工具的需求不大，或者至少没有强烈偏好。

• **推荐类似工具**：[kcb]推荐了另一个类似的系统信息工具**hardinfo2**，并将其与Windows上的**hwinfo64**相比较，暗示用户可以根据需求选择更合适的工具。

• **推荐I-Nex工具**：[xet7]推荐了**I-Nex**工具，这是一个用Gambas开发的类似项目，并提供了项目的相关链接。这一评论提供了另一种选择，展示了社区中有多种工具可以满足类似需求。

• **质疑模仿Windows外观**：[aforty]对该工具模仿Windows外观的设计选择提出质疑，认为开源社区应该追求创新，而不是模仿其他操作系统的外观和体验。

• **对后台进程的要求提出批评**：[DrillShopper]指出工具需要后台进程才能运行，认为这是一个不必要的限制，希望工具能更加轻量化。

补充讨论：
• **被标记的评论**：[mmh0000]的评论被标记，可能是因为内容无关或违反社区规则，未对讨论提供有效贡献。

争议焦点：
• 开源工具的UI设计问题：部分用户认为开源工具在功能上已经足够强大，但在UI设计上存在不足，影响了用户体验。
• 是否应模仿Windows外观：部分用户质疑该工具在设计上模仿Windows外观的选择，认为开源项目应更注重创新和独特性。
• 工具的轻量化需求：有用户对工具需要后台进程运行表示不满，认为这增加了不必要的复杂性。

总结来看，讨论围绕工具的UI设计、功能实现和设计理念展开，反映了不同用户对开源工具的期望和批评。

data.title: RapidRAW: A non-destructive and GPU-accelerated RAW image editor
data.author: l8rlump
data.article_summary: RapidRAW是一款现代、高性能、非破坏性的RAW图像编辑器，支持GPU加速，体积小巧（不到30MB），适用于Windows、macOS和Linux。它由CyberTimon开发，旨在为摄影工作流提供高效工具，同时加深对React和Rust的理解。其核心功能包括GPU加速处理、AI驱动的遮罩、广泛的RAW格式支持、非破坏性编辑、32位精度、专业的调整工具（如色调控制、颜色分级、细节增强等）、以及高效的图像库管理。近期更新包括增强的AI功能、图像评分过滤器、预设覆盖、以及对ComfyUI的初步集成。项目采用AGPL-3.0许可证。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：开源RAW图像处理工具RawTherapee及其相关话题的讨论，包括功能、性能、技术实现及与其他工具的比较。

不同观点：
• **支持RawTherapee**：[strogonoff]认为RawTherapee是最好的RAW处理工具，特别强调其色彩科学准确性、脚本支持和丰富的文档资源（RawPedia）。虽然工具涉及较多技术细节和术语，但他对其深度功能表示赞赏，唯一不足的是缺少HDR输出支持。
• **Capture One的优点**：[Melatonic]认为Capture One被低估，且易于使用，即使未使用其特定相机（PhaseOne）。这暗示了商业软件在用户体验上的优势。
• **性能问题**：[polishdude20]在M1芯片的Mac上使用RawTherapee时遇到性能问题，软件加载RAW文件时导致电脑卡顿，他对比了其他商业软件的流畅性，质疑是否因为它们是原生编写。
• **元数据和跨平台兼容性**：[pradn]关注元数据的存储方式，担心每张RAW文件对应一个影子文件的模式在云同步时不够方便，同时希望编辑数据能以开放格式存储，以便在不同软件中使用。

补充讨论：
• **功能需求**：[miladyincontrol]提出增加亮度蒙版功能的需求，认为这是许多用户期望的实用工具，特别是在无需借助Photoshop等其他软件的情况下。
• **技术实现质疑**：[dxroshan]对基于网页的图像编辑器持怀疑态度，认为这种实现方式会带来性能和资源消耗问题。
• **文档改进建议**：[Springtime]赞扬了文档中的GIF视觉指南，但建议用视频替代大文件GIF，以加快加载速度。
• **开源与商业软件对比**：[Mashimo]曾使用Darktable（开源软件），但更新后出现调色问题，目前使用盗版CaptureOne，希望找到价格合理的商业软件或可靠的开源替代品，并询问RawTherapee是否内置了相机和镜头配置文件。
• **技术问题**：[brcmthrowaway]询问了RAW和Bitmap的区别，反映了部分用户对基本概念的混淆。[dylan604]则对编辑数据存储在旁路文件而不是应用库中的技术决策表示好奇，希望了解这种设计选择的优缺点。

争议焦点：
• **性能与技术实现**：部分用户（如[polishdude20]和[dxroshan]）对软件的性能表现和技术实现方式提出质疑，特别是与商业软件的对比。
• **功能完善度**：一些用户（如[miladyincontrol]）对RawTherapee的功能需求提出了期望，尤其是与商业软件功能的对比。

其他讨论点：
• **文档与技术支持**：如[Springtime]对文档加载速度的改进建议，[rkagerer]询问系统需求页面和最低操作系统版本。
• **项目参与**：如[ioma8]表示有兴趣参与项目开发，[bjelkeman-again]询问Mac代码签名的难度。

RapidRAW
A beautiful, non-destructive, and GPU-accelerated RAW image editor built with performance in mind.
RapidRAW is a modern, high-performance alternative to Adobe Lightroom. It delivers a feature-rich, beautiful editing experience in a lightweight package (under 30MB) for Windows, macOS, and Linux.
I developed this project as a personal challenge at the age of 18. My goal was to create a high-performance tool for my own photography workflow while deepening my understanding of both React and Rust, with the support from Google Gemini.
Have fun!

Key Features
Core Editing Engine
GPU-Accelerated Processing:
All image adjustments are processed on the GPU using a custom WGSL shader for rapid feedback.
Masking:
Instantly create precise masks with AI subject and foreground detection. Combine with traditional Brush, Linear, and Radial masks for great control.
Generative Edits:
Remove objects or add new elements with text prompts. Each edit creates a non-destructive patch layer, powered by an optional ComfyUI backend.
Full RAW Support:
Supports a wide range of RAW camera formats thanks to rawler.
Non-Destructive Workflow:
All edits are stored in a
.rrdata
sidecar file, leaving your original images untouched.
32-bit Precision:
Ensures high-quality adjustments without banding or data loss.
Professional Grade Adjustments
Tonal Controls:
Exposure, Contrast, Highlights, Shadows, Whites, and Blacks.
Tone Curves:
Full control over Luma, Red, Green, and Blue channels.
Color Grading:
Temperature, Tint, Vibrance, Saturation, and a full HSL color mixer.
Detail Enhancement:
Sharpening, Clarity, Structure, and Noise Reduction.
Effects:
Dehaze, Vignette, and realistic Film Grain simulation.
Transform Tools:
Crop with aspect ratio locking, Rotate, and Flip.
Library & Workflow
Image Library:
Effortlessly sort, rate, and manage your entire photo collection for a streamlined and efficient workflow.
Folder Management:
Integrated folder tree, create, rename, and delete folders directly within the app.
File Operations:
Copy, move, and duplicate images and their associated edits.
Filmstrip View:
Quickly navigate between all the images in your current folder while editing.
Batch Operations:
Save significant time by applying a consistent set of adjustments or exporting entire batches of images simultaneously.
EXIF Data Viewer:
Gain insights by inspecting the complete metadata from your camera, including shutter speed, aperture, ISO, and lens information.
Productivity & UI
Preset System:
Create, save, import, and export your favorite looks.

• **开源与商业软件对比**：[Mashimo]曾使用Darktable（开源软件），但更新后出现调色问题，目前使用盗版CaptureOne，希望找到价格合理的商业软件或可靠的开源替代品，并询问RawTherapee是否内置了相机和镜头配置文件。
• **技术问题**：[brcmthrowaway]询问了RAW和Bitmap的区别，反映了部分用户对基本概念的混淆。[dylan604]则对编辑数据存储在旁路文件而不是应用库中的技术决策表示好奇，希望了解这种设计选择的优缺点。

争议焦点：
• **性能与技术实现**：部分用户（如[polishdude20]和[dxroshan]）对软件的性能表现和技术实现方式提出质疑，特别是与商业软件的对比。
• **功能完善度**：一些用户（如[miladyincontrol]）对RawTherapee的功能需求提出了期望，尤其是与商业软件功能的对比。

其他讨论点：
• **文档与技术支持**：如[Springtime]对文档加载速度的改进建议，[rkagerer]询问系统需求页面和最低操作系统版本。
• **项目参与**：如[ioma8]表示有兴趣参与项目开发，[bjelkeman-again]询问Mac代码签名的难度。

data.title: Frame of preference A history of Mac settings, 1984–2004
data.author: K7PJP
data.article_summary: 本文探讨了1984年至2004年间Mac电脑设置界面的演变历史。作者作为一名设计师，虽然按理应不喜欢设置选项，但作为用户却对其充满兴趣，并每年设立“设置日”来研究软件中的选项和开关。文章特别提到1984年由Susan Kare设计的Mac控制面板，这一设计至今仍被提及。最初的控制面板简洁直观，包含了动画和早期GUI实验元素，如滑块和步进器。有趣的是，当时团队对桌面定制功能存在分歧，担心用户会创建“丑陋的桌面图案”。尽管存在一些小瑕疵和操作缓慢的问题，早期控制面板依然充满魅力。到了1986年，随着时间推移，许多原有的 charm 逐渐消失。文章通过回顾Mac设置界面的发展，展示了这台机器早期历史和设计挑战。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：对一篇关于Mac电脑和操作系统的互动式文章的技术实现、用户体验和情感回忆的讨论

不同观点：
• thristian：赞赏文章的技术实现，尤其是能够模拟不同操作系统的交互功能，甚至在屏幕角度奇怪的情况下也能实现。
• dmitshur：对文章中的一段文字感到困惑，尤其是“在电脑上打开”的表述。通过调查源代码发现其设备被误认为非电脑，但作者很快添加了额外说明以解决此问题。
• tobr：提到文章作者之前也参与过类似主题的项目，强调了作者在这一领域的持续贡献。
• vintagedave：同意文章的结论，怀念早期Mac操作系统的细节和设计，认为现代macOS缺乏那种精心设计的感觉。
• rezmason：对文章中使用的技术实现非常感兴趣，尤其是如何在模拟器中调度事件，并对像素分析技术提出疑问。
• cadamsdotcom：高度赞赏文章和网站的技术和设计，认为这是对网络和Mac的致敬。
• jfvinueza：喜欢文章和网站的设计，尤其是因为它唤起了对PowerBook G4的美好回忆。
• pixelatedindex：希望能够在iPad Air上体验该网站，但对网站的设计和内容仍然给予高度评价，并提到作者关于键盘的书。
• kamel3d：批评Mac设置在Ventura版本中的改变，认为新布局让人困惑，图标设计不合理。
• kaidon：对能够在浏览器中模拟经典Mac游戏和操作系统感到惊叹，认为非常酷。
• nkotov：惊讶于能够在浏览器中运行早期版本的Mac OS X。
• PeterStuer：赞赏文章的质量，认为虽然Mac的设置和偏好不总是完美，但相比微软Windows 7后的混乱要好得多。
• geerlingguy：喜欢文章中的屏幕录制和效果，认为这些元素唤起了怀旧情绪并很好地说明了内容。
• nofunsir：提到自己仍然习惯在文件菜单中寻找“偏好设置”和“退出”选项。
• lysace：认为图标加文字标签的设计通常比单独使用图标或文字要好，这一点在历史对比中也能看到（1986年 vs 1984年）。

补充讨论：
• 争议的焦点主要集中在对现代Mac设置界面的评价上，kamel3d批评新布局让人困惑，而PeterStuer则认为相比Windows的设置混乱要好得多。
• 技术实现和用户体验是多数评论者关注的重点，尤其是互动式模拟器的使用和其背后的技术细节。
• 怀旧情绪也是一个重要的讨论点，许多评论者对早期Mac设计和操作系统表达了怀念之情。

44505171.article_content:
Frame of preference
A history of Mac settings, 1984â2004
As a designer, Iâm meant to dislike settings. As a user, I love them.
Every year I celebrate Settings Day: a day when I take a look at the options and toggles in all the apps I use. I do this out of curiosity â what was added since the last time I looked? â but also because I love this way of getting to know software: peeking under the hood, walking the back alleys, learning what has been tricky or important enough to be equipped with a checkbox.
During the last Settings Day, I had a realization that the totemic 1984 Mac control panel, designed by Susan Kare, is still to this day perhaps the only settings screen ever brought up in casual conversation.
I kept wondering about that screen, and about what happened since then. Turns out, the Mac settings have lived a far more fascinating life than I imagined, have been redesigned many times, and can tell us a lot about the early history and the troubled upbringing of this interesting machine.
Join me on a journey through the first twenty years of Macâs control panels.
1984
Itâs rare when software matches hardware so well.
Even already in 1979, the Macintosh was envisioned as a home appliance akin to a toaster or a TV. This was documented in
one of my favorite memos of all time
. Get the machine out of the box. Leave the screwdriver in the drawer. There is no step three.
Once you do that,
open the Apple menu
, and then
launch the Control Panel
, and you will find a small appliance hiding inside the machine, too. A European appliance, even âÂ outside of the title bar, there are absolutely no words present here.
The Control Panel is a handsome and tight design, put together by Susan Kare as the
last desk accessory
, just weeks before the Macâs announcement. It feels alive, depicting a perhaps surprising amount of movement sometimes via animation, sometimes via comic book-inspired conventions: soundwaves exiting the speaker, menus blinking upon activation, a finger pressing a key, the mouse rolling on the desk. Itâs also a playground of sorts for early GUI experiments: there is an early
slider
here, some
steppers
for date and time, a custom cursor, and a mini map showing a miniature desktop.
The last two are in service of the most contentious addition:
customizing the desktop pattern
. The original Mac team was divided on this one, worrying this would lead to âabominable patternsâ and therefore âugly desktopsâ â an ongoing design challenge for any setting that is not about how something works, but about how something
looks
.
Future, more garish desktop options on computers and eventually smartphones would render these early reservations quaint. This might be the best that the Mac desktop will look for about the next twenty years. But at this moment, it felt serious. The creator of
MacPaint
rebelled and built his app so that any custom background would be drawn over by a default 50% checkerboard anyway. But can you even make an ugly desktop pattern with just 64 black pixels to mess with? Maybeâ¦ The most surprising is the fact that the team also prepared 41 beautiful built-in patterns, but hid them inside this control panel with the only hints how to get them appearing in the manual.
At this point in time, this was the only way you could truly customize your Mac to fit your personality, and itâs nice that it also happens to be one thatâs fun to use, ironically perhaps inspired by MacPaint and its
FatBits
setting.
Other controls might be slightly surprising: out of just ten settings, three are dedicated to motor memory. The two keyboard toggles make sense. Even in the early 1980s, there were keyboards â terminals or electric typewriters â whose repeating style you might have gotten used to. We already knew that once something lodges itself in your fingertips, itâs really hard to override it, even consciously, so it was clever to add customization to work around that.
But the third option is for double clicking that never existed before. There werenât really decades or even years of studies done on mouse usage, either. I imagine the creators felt it was better safe than sorry.
This early Control Panel has been celebrated since, even though there are mistakes here: the inconsistent Chicago 3, the top section being one pixel too short, and an occasional uneven border. The UI, like the whole Mac, is slow and clunky â you can see the panel, the windows, even the menus struggling to be drawn with required haste. (Only the mouse pointer is speedy, and it was
a small miracle
how it got this way.)
For people using this early Mac, this was likely frustrating as hell. Today, it feels like a perfect intro for a new little machine, the best dense collection of pixels this side of
Winamp
. Itâs cute, it gets the job done, and it has tons of charm.
Control Panel embroidery
Stitched and patterned by
gmatom
1986
Two years later, and a lot of that charm is gone. Susan Kare and Steve Jo

data.title: Surfing on a Matchbox (1999)
data.author: TMWNN
data.article_summary: 1999年2月10日，斯坦福大学计算机科学家Vaughan Pratt教授打造了当时世界上最小的网页服务器，仅有火柴盒大小，使用AMD 486-SX处理器、66 MHz CPU、16 MB RAM和闪存，运行简化版Linux系统。该服务器比当时典型的台式电脑小3000倍，旨在展示可穿戴计算机的潜力。Pratt教授成立了可穿戴实验室，致力于将计算机整合进衣物中，并正在开发能识别数字手语的手套"Thumbcode"以解决数据输入问题。未来版本还将增强语音识别能力，并计划开发更强大的信用卡大小的服务器。这一技术展示了嵌入式系统连接互联网的潜力，应用范围广泛。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：技术发展的预测与实际演变，以及学术研究的价值和方向

不同观点：
• NoboruWataya认为，过去的技术预测在某些方面接近现实，但并不完全准确。他指出，虽然便携式计算机的确成为了主流，但并非以当时设想的“特殊手套”形式，而是以智能手机的形式出现。他还提到，尽管当时移动电话已经存在，且部分可以兼容互联网，但智能手机的兴起在当时并不明显。

• em3rgent0rdr对过去互联网早期时代的天真乐观表示感慨，提到当时人们曾期望未来的个人能够拥有并运行自己的网络服务器，而这一愿景并未完全实现。

• revx的评论相对简单，带有幽默感，询问当前世界上最小的网络服务器的记录保持者是什么，这可能是对早期技术预测的一种调侃或兴趣。

• teekert对学术研究的价值提出质疑，认为一些教授的工作可能是在“浪费钱”，并质疑他们是否应更专注于为社会带来实际利益的技术，而不是仅仅从事“酷炫的项目”。

补充讨论：
• teekert的观点引发了对学术研究方向的讨论，反映了部分公众对高薪教授从事非应用性研究的质疑，涉及到科技发展中市场需求与学术自由之间的张力。

• 评论中还隐含了对技术预测不确定性的讨论，尤其是当技术发展受到市场、公司和偶然因素的影响时，预测未来的困难性。

争议焦点：
• 学术研究是否应以直接社会效益为导向，还是应允许自由探索“酷炫的”概念和技术，这是评论中反映的主要争议。

Wednesday, February 10, 1999 Published at 13:05 GMT
Sci/Tech
Surfing on a matchbox
This computer runs a web site
The smallest web server yet has been built and is now running a website.
It is one tenth the size of a Palm Pilot and dwarfed by a typical desktop computer, which is 3,000 times larger.
The matchbox-sized server was built from standard components by Professor Vaughan Pratt, a computer scientist at Stanford University, California.
"It's basically a powerful little computer and we could have set it up for a number of different uses," he said. "But, because most people think of servers as mysterious boxes, located in dark basements, I thought making it into a web server was particularly dramatic."
Computer clothes
The new Stanford web server is one of the first projects from a new Wearables Laboratory that Professor Pratt has started to develop computers that can be incorporated in clothing.
"Put this computer into your shirt pocket, hook it to a wireless modem, and you could carry it around with you," Professor Pratt says.
The tiny computer's vital statistics are:
6.9 x 4.3 x 0.6 cm in size
AMD 486-SX computer,
66 MHz CPU
16 MB RAM
16 MB flash ROM
partial version of RedHat 5.2 Linux operating system
2 watts from a 5V power supply at 100% CPU usage
Professor Pratt believes the biggest obstacle to a truly wearable computer is the lack of an easy, compact way of inputting data. Professor Pratt and doctoral student Greg Defouw are now working on a special glove that can recognize a digital sign language, called Thumbcode.
The talking type
Future versions of the matchbox computer should be powerful enough to run voice recognition software, he says.
The Wearables group is already working on a more powerful server, combining a credit-card-size Pentium motherboard with a new 340 MB hard drive from IBM that is a fraction of an inch thick and less than five centimetres on a side.
The previous world's smallest web server was a custom computer from Phar Lap Software, more than 10 times the size of the new one. The Phar Lap server provides up-to-date local weather data for Cambridge, Massachusetts.
Its purpose is to show how "embedded systems" can connect to the World Wide Web. Embedded systems are computers fitted in devices ranging from refrigerators to lifts to medical instruments.

data.article_summary: libpostal是一个开源的C语言库，用于解析和标准化全球街道地址。它利用统计自然语言处理（NLP）和开放地理数据，目标是理解各种语言的地址格式。该库可以将人类使用的非结构化地址转换为规范形式，便于机器对比和全文索引，特别适用于地图、交通、快递等应用。虽然libpostal本身不是完整的地理编码器，但可以作为预处理步骤，提高国际化地址处理的智能性和一致性。该项目支持Python、Ruby、Go、Java、PHP和NodeJS等多种语言绑定，并提供了详细的安装指南。公司和个人可以通过赞助或捐赠支持该项目的持续发展。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：地址解析和规范化的复杂性及其实现工具（如libpostal）的有效性

不同观点：
• **支持libpostal的观点**：
   - **Ameo**：在之前公司使用libpostal取得了较好的效果，能够相对轻松地将原始地址字符串解析为结构化数据。
   - **alganet**：认为libpostal比正则表达式表现更好。
   - **weinzierl**：提到Google的libphonenumber库在处理国际电话号码上的类似经验，并指出许多公司使用商业服务来进行地址和电话号码的验证和规范化。

• **对地址解析持怀疑态度的观点**：
   - **shakna**：质疑地址标准化的可行性，以自己在澳大利亚的非标准化地址为例，说明实际地址可能不符合常规格式。
   - **jandrese**：指出不同国家和地区的非正式标准和人们的随意性使得地址验证成为一个几乎无法解决的问题。

• **对libpostal的批评和替代建议**：
   - **kerkeslager**：认为地址本质上是无结构的数据，地址解析和规范化库难以有效工作。主张使用搜索库来验证地址是否存在于真实世界的地址数据集中，而不是依赖解析库。
   - **RobinL**：警告不要将libpostal作为地址匹配的主要方法，认为最难解析的地址往往也是最难匹配的，主张结合其他方法。

补充讨论：
• **技术实现和资源需求**：
   - **claytongulick**：指出libpostal需要大量的存储空间和显著的运行时资源，建议将其部署为独立服务。
   
• **其他相关资源和讨论**：
   - **degamad**：提供了之前关于libpostal的讨论链接，帮助扩展阅读。
   - **ttw44**：分享了自己在网页开发中处理地址输入时的困惑和放弃经历。
   - **gorgoiler**：表达了对日常事物编码化的兴趣，提到其他相关项目如tzdata、GNU units等。

争议焦点：
• 地址解析和规范化的可行性及其实际效果，特别是在面对非标准化地址时。

libpostal: international street address NLP
libpostal is a C library for parsing/normalizing street addresses around the world using statistical NLP and open data. The goal of this project is to understand location-based strings in every language, everywhere. For a more comprehensive overview of the research behind libpostal, be sure to check out the (lengthy) introductory blog posts:
Original post
:
Statistical NLP on OpenStreetMap
Follow-up for 1.0 release
:
Statistical NLP on OpenStreetMap: Part 2

Addresses and the locations they represent are essential for any application dealing with maps (place search, transportation, on-demand/delivery services, check-ins, reviews). Yet even the simplest addresses are packed with local conventions, abbreviations and context, making them difficult to index/query effectively with traditional full-text search engines. This library helps convert the free-form addresses that humans use into clean normalized forms suitable for machine comparison and full-text indexing. Though libpostal is not itself a full geocoder, it can be used as a preprocessing step to make any geocoding application smarter, simpler, and more consistent internationally.

The core library is written in pure C. Language bindings for
Python
,
Ruby
,
Go
,
Java
,
PHP
, and
NodeJS
are officially supported and it's easy to write bindings in other languages.
Sponsors
If your company is using libpostal, consider asking your organization to sponsor the project. Interpreting what humans mean when they refer to locations is far from a solved problem, and sponsorships help us pursue new frontiers in geospatial NLP. As a sponsor, your company logo will appear prominently on the Github repo page along with a link to your site.
Sponsorship info
Backers
Individual users can also help support open geo NLP research by making a monthly donation:
Installation (Mac/Linux)
Before you install, make sure you have the following prerequisites:
On Ubuntu/Debian
sudo apt-get install -y curl build-essential autoconf automake libtool pkg-config
On CentOS/RHEL
sudo yum install curl autoconf automake libtool pkgconfig
On macOS
Install with one command via
MacPorts
:
port install libpostal
Or as follows with
Homebrew
:
brew install curl autoconf automake libtool pkg-config
Then to install the C library:
If you're using an M1 Mac, add
--disable-sse2
to the
./configure
command. This will result in poorer performance but the build will succeed.
git clone https://github.com/openvenues/libpostal
cd libpostal
# skip if installing for the first time
make distclean
./bootstrap.sh
# omit --datadir flag to install data in current directory
./configure --datadir=[...some dir with a few GB of space where a "libpostal" directory exists or can be created/modified...]
make -j4
# For Intel/AMD processors and the default model
./configure --datadir=[...some dir with a few GB of space where a "libpostal" directory exists or can be created/modified...]
# For Apple / ARM cpus and the default model
./configure --datadir=[...some dir with a few GB of space where a "libpostal" directory exists or can be created/modified...] --disable-sse2
# For the improved Senzing model:
./configure --datadir=[...some dir with a few GB of space where a "libpostal" directory exists or can be created/modified...] MODEL=senzing
make -j8
sudo make install
# On Linux it's probably a good idea to run
sudo ldconfig
libpostal has support for pkg-config, so you can use the pkg-config to print the flags needed to link your program against it:
pkg-config --cflags libpostal         # print compiler flags
pkg-config --libs libpostal           # print linker flags
pkg-config --cflags --l

data.title: Ptar: Replacing .tgz for petabyte-scale S3 archives
data.author: vcoisne
data.article_summary: 文章介绍了传统备份工具`.tgz`在面对现代大数据需求时的不足，并推出了一种新的归档工具`.ptar`，由Plakar项目开发。`.tgz`在处理海量数据、多版本控制、完整性验证、加密及云存储（如S3）等方面存在局限，而`.ptar`则提供了自动去重、内置加密、完整性验证、版本控制及直接支持S3等功能，解决了`.tgz`的诸多问题。通过实际示例展示了`.ptar`在处理重复数据时的效率更高，适用于大规模数据备份和存档需求。文章最后提供了`.ptar`工具的下载和使用方法，并指出其特别适合冗余数据较多的场景。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：用户对Plakar及其相关备份工具的评价和比较

不同观点：
• [ahofmann] 对Plakar的定位存在疑问，将其与restic、Borgbackup和Kopia等类似工具进行比较，试图了解其独特之处。
• [tux1968] 提到Plakar提供了一个独立的工具（Kapsul）来读写ptar档案，以满足不想安装完整Plakar软件的用户需求。
• [chungy] 引入另一个类似的档案格式WIM，并指出其具有类似的去重、索引、文件压缩和版本控制优势，提供了一个开源实现（wimlib）作为参考。
• [winrid] 提到网站的用户体验问题，特别是cookies提示出现前无法缩放的问题，偏离了技术讨论的主线。
• [ac29] 质疑在2025年新项目中继续使用gzip的合理性，建议使用更现代的压缩算法如zstd，指出即使是保守的Debian也在2017年就开始支持zstd。
• [Scaevolus] 讨论单文件备份的实用性，认为Restic在增量性能上可能更优，但在处理大容量数据时内存使用表现不佳，而Plakar的ptar可能在大数据量情况下有更好的扩展性。
• [nemothekid] 对S3数据备份的必要性提出疑问，认为S3的可靠性已经非常高，是否还需要额外的备份方案，讨论了多云冗余和传统备份系统（如磁带）的场景。
• [gcr] 将Plakar与zpaq和dwarFS进行比较，指出zpaq也是一个成熟的去重和版本控制工具。
• [throwaway127482] 关注Plakar是否支持基于内容定义的分块（CDC），这是一个技术实现上的具体问题。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点之一是不同备份工具在性能、扩展性和实用性上的比较，特别是Plakar与Restic、zpaq等工具的差异。
• 另一个值得注意的讨论点是压缩算法的选择，以及在现代项目中继续使用传统工具和算法的合理性。
• 用户对S3的可靠性有较高的信任度，但也有关于是否需要额外备份的不同看法，特别是针对多云冗余和特定灾难恢复计划的讨论。

44490213.article_content:
Julien Mangeard
Co-Founder @ Plakar Korp
Hi, Iâm Julien, co-founder of Plakar.
Before we built this, I spent years as an engineer and later as a manager of infra teams. We handled backups, compliance, and recovery.
In every place, startups, big companies, regulated sectors, I saw the same routine:
tar -czf archive.tgz /some/folder
We all love that command. But in 2025, it can cause trouble.
Whatâs changed since
.tgz
was invented
Back when tar came out in 1979 or even gzip came out in 1994, things were simple:
Data was small, just a few megabytes.
Storage was local and trusted.
Versioning was not a big deal.
Archives ran in one pass, so you had to decompress everything to get one file.
Now none of that fits our needs.
Over the years data grew huge, like terabytes of logs or model checkpoints. We rely on multiâcore work to finish weeks of processing in minutes. We must assume zero trust, so we need proof no one changed anything. Data sits in S3 and other object stores, not on a local disk. We need to track versions and snapshots. And we often want a single file instantly, without waiting for a full decompress.
Plain old
.tgz
was never made for this.
Why
.tgz
does not work with S3
On a traditional POSIX filesystem, many teams run periodic .tgz snapshots of local disks or NFS shares.
By contrast, S3 buckets are rarely backed up (a rather short-sighted approach for mission-critical cloud data), and even one-off archives are rarely done.
If you want to archive an S3 bucket with
tar
and
gzip
, you:
Download everything to your machine (generating storage cost and/or storage cost).
Run tar.
Maybe encrypt separately.
Calculate checksums by hand.
Upload back your archive somewhere else.
Then, if you need to prove integrity or restore just one file, youâre stuck.
.tgz
canât help.
This process is slow, error-prone, and costly. It does not scale to large datasets or S3 buckets.
What we needed instead
We realized we needed an archive that could:
remove duplicate data automatically to limit storage and transfer costs
encrypt by default to protect sensitive data
store snapshots and history
check integrity with cryptography
talk to S3 and other object stores directly
let you restore parts of an archive on demand
That led us to create Plakar for Backup, it’s storage engine Kloset and now
.ptar
the flat file version of Kloset.
How
.ptar
works
Instead of a simple byte stream, a
.ptar
archive is a selfâcontained, contentâaddressed container.
Here is what it gives you:
deduplication: identical chunks stored once, even across snapshots
builtâin encryption: no extra step
tamper evidence: any change breaks the archive
versioning: keep many snapshots easily
S3 native: one command to archive a bucket
partial restores and browsing: pick a file without unpacking it all
fast targeted restores: grab one file in seconds
A simple example
Suppose I have 11 GB in my Documents and two copies of the same folder:
$ du -sh ~/Documents
11G     /Users/julien/Documents
$ tar -czf test.tgz ~/Documents ~/Documents
Result: about 22 GB compressed.
With
.ptar
:
$ plakar ptar -plaintext -o test.ptar ~/Documents ~/Documents
Result: about 8 GB. Why?
.ptar
sees the duplicate folder once.
In many real-world datasets, a large amount of data is actually redundant: multiple copies, backups, archives, or repeated files across folders. Traditional tools like tar compress everything, even duplicates, which unnecessarily increases the size of the archive. .ptar works differently: it automatically detects and removes duplicates, so each unique chunk is stored only once, no matter how many times it appears. That is why, in the example above, .ptar produces a much smaller archive than .tgz. At large scale, the space savings become significant.
When
.tgz
still makes sense
I admit,
.tgz
is everywhere:
It runs almost anywhere, no dependencies.
It is great for small, throwaway archives.
But when you need trust, speed, and scale,
.ptar
is built for 2025.
Try
.ptar
Get the dev build:
$ go install github.com/PlakarKorp/plakar@v1.0.3-devel.c7a66f1
Then:
archive a folder:
$ plakar ptar -o backup.ptar ~/Documents
archive an S3 bucket:
$ plakar ptar -o backup.ptar s3://my-bucket
list contents:
$ plakar at backup.ptar ls
restore files:
$ plakar at backup.ptar restore -to ./restore /Documents/config.yaml
inspect one file:
$ plakar at backup.ptar cat snapshotid:/path/to/file
mount a UI:
$ plakar at backup.ptar ui
About
.ptar
and Plakar
.ptar
is part of Plakar, our openâsource backup engine for immutable, deduplicated, and encrypted data. It is in the Plakar CLI today, and soon will ship as a standalone binary if you only need archiving.
The code is open source, so feel free to contribute or give feedback.
.ptar
and Plakar are doing the biggest difference on datasets with lots of redundancy, such as:
Backups with multiple versions of the same files or folders
Email, photo, or document archives containing duplicates
S3 buckets with snapshots, backups, or files shared

44505675.article_content:
A federal appeals court has clicked cancel on the FTC’s ‘click to cancel’ rule.
Photograph: filadendron/Getty Images
View image in fullscreen
A federal appeals court has clicked cancel on the FTC’s ‘click to cancel’ rule.
Photograph: filadendron/Getty Images
US news
US court strikes down ‘click-to-cancel’ rule designed to make unsubscribing easier
Rule would have kept businesses from forcing customers through lengthy chats or other barriers to cancellation
Joseph Gedeon
in Washington
Tue 8 Jul 2025 16.17 EDT
Last modified on Tue 8 Jul 2025 16.40 EDT
Share
A federal rule designed to make canceling subscriptions as easy as signing up for them has been struck down by a US federal appeals court just days before it was scheduled to take effect.
The US court of appeals for the eighth circuit vacated the Federal Trade Commission’s “click-to-cancel” rule, which would have required companies to allow consumers to cancel subscriptions using the same method they used to sign up, after finding that the commission behind it failed to follow required procedures under the FTC Act during the rule-making process.
“While we certainly do not endorse the use of unfair and deceptive practices in negative option marketing, the procedural deficiencies of the Commission’s rulemaking process are fatal here,” the court wrote, adding that “vacatur of the entire Rule is appropriate in this case because of the prejudice suffered by Petitioners as a result of the Commission’s procedural error”.
The vacated rule meant to go into effect on 14 July would have covered all forms of negative option marketing – programs that allow sellers to interpret customer inaction as acceptance of subscriptions, often leading to unintended charges. The FTC’s
original 1973 rule
only covered limited forms of these practices.
It would have also stopped businesses from forcing customers through lengthy chat sessions with agents or creating other barriers to cancellation.
The decision represents a major victory for businesses that challenged the FTC’s authority to modernize consumer protections without following what they argued were mandatory procedural requirements.
Meanwhile, Letitia James had been encouraging consumers to prepare for the rule’s implementation, writing in a Tuesday press release that “New Yorkers should never have to jump through hoops just to cancel an unwanted subscription”.
The New York attorney general’s office told the Guardian that the office is reviewing the decision.
The commission has faced mounting complaints about subscription practices, receiving nearly 70
consumer complaints per day
in 2024, up from 42 daily complaints in 2021. The rule applies to almost all negative option programs across any media platform.
Similar state rules had yielded results in New York, where James says she’s secured $600,000 in penalties from Equinox for making cancellations difficult and won a lawsuit against SiriusXM for trapping customers in unwanted subscriptions.
The decision may now force the FTC to restart its rule-making process and could influence how the agency approaches future consumer protection regulations.

data.title: Swahili on the Road
data.author: Thevet
data.article_summary: 文章探讨了斯瓦希里语如何成为东非通用语言的过程及其重要性。斯瓦希里语的传播始于19世纪中叶，随着象牙和奴隶贸易的扩大，沿海的商路将其带入内陆市场，使其成为地区通用语。19世纪后期，欧洲传教士对斯瓦希里语进行了拉丁字母标准化，为后来的殖民行政和现代标准斯瓦希里语奠定了基础。1954年，坦噶尼喀非洲民族联盟（TANU）采用斯瓦希里语作为独立运动语言，朱利叶斯·尼雷尔通过演讲推广该语言，使其在独立后的坦桑尼亚成为国家建设的核心。尼雷尔提出的“乌贾马”哲学，强调家庭和社区精神，进一步巩固了斯瓦希里语在国家事务中的地位。到2021年，联合国教科文组织将7月7日定为世界斯瓦希里语日，标志其全球影响力。如今，斯瓦希里语在东非及其他地区广泛使用，但也对其他本地语言构成挑战。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：斯瓦希里语言和文化的多重历史根源，以及其在东非的发展和影响。

不同观点：
• [pazimzadeh] 引用了一项基因研究，强调中世纪斯瓦希里海岸居民的非洲与波斯祖先的混合，并指出这一发现与历史文献《基尔瓦编年史》中的记载相符。该研究还提到，波斯对斯瓦希里语言的影响有限，仅有约3%的词汇来自波斯语，但具体来源不明。

• [georgeg] 以东非人的身份回应，认为文章未充分探讨斯瓦希里语言在东非历史中的重要性。他指出，斯瓦希里不仅是坦桑尼亚的官方语言，还在更广泛的东非地区（从索马里到莫桑比克）作为贸易语言使用了几千年。他还强调斯瓦希里语言的混合特性，包括班图、阿拉伯语以及葡萄牙语借词，并认为将斯瓦希里的成功仅归因于坦桑尼亚是短视的。

补充讨论：
• [callistus] 对文章表示感谢，特别提到尼雷尔（坦桑尼亚前总统）在斯瓦希里语言推广中的作用。

• [muragekibicho] 提到无法访问文章链接，可能由于技术问题（如网站宕机或地理封锁），这引发了对信息获取不平等的潜在关注。

• 斯瓦希里语言成功的核心原因：[georgeg] 反对将斯瓦希里语言的成功仅归因于坦桑尼亚，强调其在更广泛的东非地区的历史和文化重要性。

• 波斯对斯瓦希里语言的影响：[pazimzadeh] 引用研究表明波斯基因和词汇对斯瓦希里有影响，但[georgeg] 的回应隐含了对这种单一文化影响解释的质疑，强调了斯瓦希里语言的多源性。

Behind the Times
Swahili on the Road
How did Swahili become an East African lingua franca? It was not by accident.
Morgan J. Robinson
| Published in
History Today
Volume 75 Issue 7 July 2025
I
n March 1960 Julius Nyerere – then leader of the Tanganyika African National Union (TANU) – sat down with former first lady Eleanor Roosevelt on her roundtable discussion programme
Prospects of Mankind
. The topic was ‘Africa: A Revolution in Haste’. Although he found himself in a sympathetic circle of interlocutors, Nyerere was asked to defend the ‘readiness’ of African peoples for independence. Good-humoured but resolute, he replied: ‘If you come into my house and steal my jacket, don’t then ask me whether I am ready for my jacket. The jacket was mine, you had no right at all to take it from me … I may not look as smart in it as you look in it, but it’s mine.’ With a simple analogy, Nyerere swept aside the argument that decolonisation was happening too quickly. And though this defence was delivered in composed and commanding English – the language of his degrees at Makerere College in Uganda and Edinburgh University – the language that Nyerere championed at home was Swahili.
In 2021 UNESCO designated 7 July as World Kiswahili Language Day. Swahili is the first African language to be given such a distinction. The date was chosen to mark the decision made by TANU in 1954 to adopt Swahili as the language of its independence movement. Founded by Nyerere two days earlier on 5 July 1954, TANU was Tanganyika’s nationalist party. Over the course of the 1950s TANU demanded – and ultimately achieved – independence, Tanganyika becoming self-governing under the British Crown in 1961, and a full republic with Nyerere as president the following year. At his independence address in December 1961, Nyerere thanked Queen Elizabeth II in English; henceforth, the nation would be built with Swahili.
On the road
Swahili’s centrality in independent Tanganyika was not inevitable. For centuries, it was just one of the region’s more than 120 languages, its speakers concentrated along the Indian Ocean (or, ‘Swahili’) coast. But in the mid-19th century, as demand for ivory and enslaved people expanded, local trade routes in central Africa became incorporated into a global network centred around the Indian Ocean. Caravan routes carried Swahili from coastal ports to interior market towns as an East African lingua franca.
The 19th century also brought orthographic changes to Swahili. Written for centuries with a modified version of the Arabic script, by the middle of the century Swahili’s European partisans had begun the slow process of its Latin standardisation. Starting in 1864, schools run by the Universities’ Mission to Central Africa on Zanzibar took in formerly enslaved children and produced a series of handbooks that, decades later, would be adopted by the British colonial regime as the basis of its administrative Swahili. This established the foundation for the language that is now taught in East Africa and beyond as Standard Swahili, or Kiswahili Sanifu.
As the UN recognised in 2021, Swahili today is a global force, spoken (in all its varieties) by more than 200 million people. It is a national or official language in Tanzania, Kenya, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Rwanda, and Uganda, as well as a working language of the African Union, the East African Community, and the Southern African Development Community. Such is Swahili’s postcolonial force that it has been described by the linguist John Mugane as a ‘linguistic tsunami’, a behemoth the success of which has come at the expense of other East African languages such as Chagga, Sukuma, Bondei, and Zaramo. How did Swahili come to inhabit this powerful position?
Ujamaa
Following the establishment of TANU in 1954, Nyerere and his fellow organisers crisscrossed Tanganyika territory, delivering speeches and encouraging people to join the movement. Addressing his audiences in Swahili, Nyerere later remembered requiring an interpreter on only three occasions (in the Mwanza region near Lake Victoria, for example, Sukuma was found to be more effective than Swahili). TANU made the language central to the fight for independence and, following its achievement, to Tanganyikan nation building. (The country officially became the Republic of Tanzania after the 1964 union with Zanzibar.)
Swahili’s importance was implicit in the philosophy which Nyerere chose to guide Tanzania’s postcolonial path, the concept of ujamaa. A Swahili word meaning ‘familyhood’, it is often glossed as ‘African socialism’. In a 1962 essay, ‘Ujamaa: The Basis of African Socialism’, Nyerere described the ideals embedded within the term: ‘We, in Africa, have no more need of being “converted” to socialism than we have of being “taught” democracy. Both are rooted in our own past.’ The basic unit of the family, and the care that one took for its members, was to be extended to the nation, the continent, and, indeed, to ‘the who

data.title: Choosing a Database Schema for Polymorphic Data (2024)
data.author: gm678
data.article_summary: 这篇文章讨论了在关系型数据库中设计模式时面临的挑战，尤其是处理多态数据（polymorphic data）的困难。多态数据是指可以有多种不同形态的数据类型。文章以患者支付信息为例，说明了如何在SQL中建模这种数据。文章介绍了一种简单的方案——使用具有可空字段的单表模式，即“单表继承”或“层次表”，但这种方法存在一些问题，如难以验证数据的不变性、错误信息不明确以及未来扩展性差。此外，随着数据集的增大，这种设计可能导致性能问题。文章还提到，尽管可以对表添加约束来解决部分问题，但这些约束会变得复杂且难以维护。最终，这种方案需要在数据完整性、可扩展性和性能之间做出权衡。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：在处理数据库中的多态数据和复杂数据结构时，不同技术的优缺点和选择。

不同观点：
• reaanb2 认为SQL中的检查约束和存储过程可以提供更好的错误信息和事务管理。他建议结合使用存储过程与特定数据库设计（如主键和唯一键）来处理多态数据，并提到SQL在处理外键约束和排除约束方面的不足。
• bob1029 讨论了JSON作为blob列的优缺点，指出在某些情况下（如使用快速序列化器时），JSON blob可以很好地工作，但当需要跨JSON属性进行连接时，JSON可能不是最佳选择。
• gm678 引用了Martin Fowler的企业应用架构模式，如单表继承、类表继承和具体表继承，认为这些模式可以应用于当前讨论的问题。
• 1st1 提到Gel语言中对多态模式和查询的支持，认为这是处理多态数据的一种简便方法。

44505165.article_content:
Blog
Designing a schema for your relational database is a daunting task that has long term implications for the database's performance, maintainability, and correctness. And it often requires making decisions before having a clear picture of the exact shape and distribution of your data, or what the common access patterns will look like. It's not a permanent decision: tables can be altered and databases migrated. But these migrations can be slow and expensive.
To top it all off, some data is less amenable to relational modeling than others.
Polymorphic Data
, in particular, is a common occurrence that is difficult to model in SQL. You've probably worked with polymorphic data before, even if you're not familiar with the term.
Example: Patient Payment Info
Imagine you're a medical provider storing patient payment methods. Every patient is either insured or uninsured, and you need to store different data for each patient based on their insurance status.
If you've written code in a functional language, you might be familiar with algebraic data types. For instance, you could represent this schema in Haskell with the following ADT:
type
Provider
=
String
type
MemberId
=
Int
type
CardNumber
=
String
type
BillingAddress
=
String
data
PaymentInfo
=
Insured
Provider
MemberId
|
Uninsured
CardNumber
BillingAddress
If you're more accustomed to object oriented programming, you might implement this same data type via abstract classes and inheritance, like the following Java code:
abstract
class
PaymentInfo
{
}
class
Insured
extends
PaymentInfo
{
String
provider
;
int
memberId
;
}
class
Uninsured
extends
PaymentInfo
{
String
cardNumber
;
String
billingAddress
;
}
These are both examples of polymorphic data: a datatype where the data can take multiple different shapes. The word comes from Greek roots: "poly" meaning many, and "morph" meaning form. So, data that can take many forms. When a relational database needs to model polymorphic data, we typically use the term
polymorphic association
instead.
Sometimes, like in the above example, a polymorphic association is the best way to model your data type. But there's no obvious way to represent this data in a relational database. If you want to include data like this in your database, you're going to have to make some tradeoffs.
Let's look at some different schemas that attempt to model this data. We're going to use MySQL as our chosen dialect here, but the process is similar regardless of dialect.
Approach 1 - Single Table With Nullable Fields
The simplest schema would be one that has a single table, with a field for each value that
may
appear in a record, or may be
NULL
. Such a schema would look like this:
CREATE
TABLE
patients
(
id
INT
PRIMARY
KEY
,
insurance_provider
TEXT
,
insurance_member_id
INT
,
card_number
TEXT
,
billing_address
TEXT
)
;
In each row, we set
insurance_provider
and
insurance_member_id
if the patient is insured, and
card_number
and
billing_address
if the patient is uninsured. The unused fields get set to
NULL
.
This technique is sometimes also called "Single Table Inheritance" or "Table-Per-Hierarchy", because a single table is used to represent an entire hierarchy of types.
This works, but it has several problems. Mainly, our data has several invariants that the database cannot easily validate. Among them:
In a single row, the fields for insured and uninsured patients should not both be set to non-NULL values.
We would like to enforce that
insurance_member_id
cannot be NULL for insured patients, but we can't add a
NOT NULL
constraint on the column, because it also
must
be
NULL
for uninsured patients.
We can add constraints to the table, but they're pretty obtuse, and the error messages if the constraints get violated are opaque:
CREATE
TABLE
patients
(
id
INT
PRIMARY
KEY
,
insurance_provider
TEXT
,
insurance_member_id
INT
,
card_number
TEXT
,
billing_address
TEXT
,
CHECK
(
(
insurance_provider
IS
NULL
)
=
(
insurance_member_id
IS
NULL
)
)
,
CHECK
(
(
card_number
IS
NULL
)
=
(
billing_address
IS
NULL
)
)
,
CHECK
(
(
insurance_provider
IS
NULL
)
+
(
card_number
IS
NULL
)
=
1
)
)
;
This will result in an error if we attempt to insert a patient record with neither payment type or both payment types, but the error message isn't very helpful:
>
INSERT
INTO
patients
(
id
,
insurance_provider
,
insurance_member_id
)
VALUES
(
1
,
"OneMedical"
,
NULL
)
;
ERROR
3819
(
HY000
)
at line
1
:
Check
constraint
'patients_chk_1'
is
violated
.
These checks would only grow in complexity as the number of fields in each payment method grows. And what if we later want to add a third type of payment info? We'd have to add additional columns to the table, modifying every existing row and changing the table schema.
There's another, more subtle issue happening here: performance. A schema like this is fast for small datasets because storing all the records in a single table allows the engine to perform fewer joins. But as the size of the dataset grows, this table could become a bot

data.article_summary: 国际研究团队通过分析六种哺乳动物的单细胞转录组，揭示了胎儿与母体界面细胞类型和通讯网络的进化过程，该界面是胎盘哺乳动物成功妊娠的关键。研究发现，胎儿的胎盘细胞侵入母体组织，而母体子宫基质细胞对此作出反应，这种行为在哺乳动物中已存在超过1亿年。此外，研究支持了“去模糊化假说”，即胎儿和母体之间的激素信号逐渐明确分配，以防止操纵。尽管存在一定的基因冲突，总体上母体和胎儿之间的信号传递更倾向于协调合作。这些发现发表于《Nature Ecology & Evolution》期刊。
